```{r}
# Function to select all the columns of all aa mut annotations
select_mutation_fitness_cols <- function(df, prefix = "gene_sub_aa_mut_") {
  # Define columns to keep in addition to the prefix ones
  extra_cols <- c(
    # Global test 
    "p_value_two_sample_ttest_syn",
    "p_value_two_sample_ttest_syn_FDR",
    "effect_size_vs_syn",
    "effect_size_std_vs_syn",
    "effect_size_bin",
    
    # Global mutation category
    "mutation_category_FDR",
    "mutation_category_FDR_lethal",
    "mutation_category_FDR_cutoff",
    "mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_combined",
    
    # Variants subset test
    "p_value_AA_two_sample_ttest_syn",
    "p_value_AA_two_sample_ttest_syn_FDR",
    "effect_size_vs_AA_syn",
    "effect_size_std_vs_AA_syn",
    "effect_size_bin_AA",
    
    # Variants subset mutation category
    "mutation_category_FDR_AA",
    "mutation_category_FDR_lethal_AA",
    "mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_AA",
    "mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_AA_combined",
    
    "fitness_final_unique",
    "sigma_final_unique",
    "phix_aa_mut_ham", 
    "phix_aa_mut_class_sum",
    "phix_aa_mut_class_all"
  )
  
  # Select prefixed + extra columns
  selected_df <- df %>%
    select(
      starts_with(prefix),
      all_of(extra_cols)
    )
  
  # Rename prefixed columns
  rename_map <- setNames(
    nm = paste0("aa_mut_", sub(prefix, "", grep(paste0("^", prefix), names(selected_df), value = TRUE))),
    object = grep(paste0("^", prefix), names(selected_df), value = TRUE)
  )
  
  selected_df <- selected_df %>%
    rename(!!!rename_map)
  
  # Add ORF category based on phix_aa_mut_ham
  selected_df <- selected_df %>%
    mutate(
      phix_aa_mut_orf_class = case_when(
        phix_aa_mut_ham > 1 ~ "multi_orf",
        phix_aa_mut_ham == 1 ~ "single_orf",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      phix_aa_mut_combined = NA_character_  # Placeholder column
    )
  
  return(selected_df)
}



# Function to update aa mut annotations
aa_seq_differ_update_rows <- function(df, seq_col = "aa_mut_seq", wt_seq) {
  # Extract mutant sequences and split into characters
  mut_seqs <- as.character(df[[seq_col]])
  mut_split <- strsplit(mut_seqs, split = "")
  wt_split <- strsplit(wt_seq, split = "")[[1]]
  
  # Compare to wild-type
  pos.aa <- character(length(mut_split))
  sub.aa <- character(length(mut_split))
  nd.aa  <- character(length(mut_split))
  
  for (i in seq_along(mut_split)) {
    mut <- mut_split[[i]]
    diff_idx <- which(mut != wt_split)
    pos.aa[i] <- paste(diff_idx, collapse = ",")
    sub.aa[i] <- paste(mut[diff_idx], collapse = ",")
    nd.aa[i]  <- paste(wt_split[diff_idx], collapse = ",")
  }
  
  # Assign updated values
  df$aa_mut_pos <- pos.aa
  df$aa_mut_sub <- sub.aa
  df$aa_mut_wt  <- nd.aa
  df$aa_mut_ID  <- paste0("gp", df$aa_mut_gene, "_", df$aa_mut_wt, df$aa_mut_pos, df$aa_mut_sub)
  
  # Assign updated mutation class
  df$aa_mut_class <- mapply(function(wt, sub) {
    wt_vec <- unlist(strsplit(wt, ","))
    sub_vec <- unlist(strsplit(sub, ","))
    
    if (all(is.na(sub_vec))) return(NA)
    
    class_list <- sapply(seq_along(wt_vec), function(j) {
      if (j > length(sub_vec) || is.na(sub_vec[j])) return(NA)
      if (wt_vec[j] == "*" && sub_vec[j] == "*") return("Synonymous")
      else if (wt_vec[j] == "*" && sub_vec[j] != "*") return("Stop-loss")
      else if (sub_vec[j] == "*") return("Nonsense")
      else if (sub_vec[j] == "syn") return("Synonymous")
      else if (wt_vec[j] == sub_vec[j]) return("Synonymous")
      else return("Missense")
    })
    
    paste(class_list, collapse = ",")
  }, df$aa_mut_wt, df$aa_mut_sub)
  
  return(df)
}



# Function to unique substitution aa mut ID at proteins data.frames
# ---- small helper ----
safe_first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA)
  } else {
    return(x[1])
  }
}



# Function to unique Synonymous aa mut ID at proteins data.frames 
# Error is propagated measurement error SEM
unique_syn_aa_mut_ID_protein_fitness <- function(
  df,
  fitness_col = "fitness_final_unique",
  sigma_col   = "sigma_final_unique",
  out_mean_col = "fitness_aa_mut",
  out_sd_background_col  = "SD_background",
  out_sem_background_col = "SEM_background",
  out_sem_col  = "sem_aa_mut",
  out_n_col    = "aa_mut_background_count"
) {

  library(dplyr)

  # ---- Checks ----
  if (!"aa_mut_ID" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Missing 'aa_mut_ID' column")
  }

  if (!fitness_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Missing fitness column:", fitness_col))
  }

  if (!sigma_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Missing sigma column:", sigma_col))
  }

  # ---- Ensure optional metadata columns exist ----
  optional_cols <- c(
    "aa_mut_seq",
    "aa_mut_gene",
    "aa_mut_structure",
    "aa_mut_pos",
    "aa_mut_wt",
    "aa_mut_sub",
    "aa_mut_class",
    "aa_mut_ham",
    "phix_aa_mut_ham"
  )

  for (col in optional_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) {
      df[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }

  # ---- Summarise ----
  result <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[["aa_mut_ID"]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[["aa_mut_ID"]]) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(

      # ---- background count ----
      !!out_n_col := sum(!is.na(.data[[fitness_col]])),

      # ---- amino-acid-level fitness ----
      !!out_mean_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        if (all(is.na(f))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          mean(f, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      },

      # ---- descriptive background SD ----
      !!out_sd_background_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        f <- f[!is.na(f)]

        if (length(f) > 1) {
          sd(f)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },

      # ---- descriptive background SEM ----
      !!out_sem_background_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        f <- f[!is.na(f)]

        if (length(f) > 1) {
          sd(f) / sqrt(length(f))
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },

      # ---- propagated measurement-level SEM ----
      # Formula: sqrt(sum(sigma_i^2)) / n
      !!out_sem_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        s <- .data[[sigma_col]]

        keep <- !is.na(f)
        s <- s[keep]

        n_eff <- length(s)

        if (n_eff == 0) {
          NA_real_
        } else if (any(is.na(s))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          sqrt(sum(s^2)) / n_eff
        }
      },

      # ---- metadata ----
      aa_mut_seq       = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_seq"]]),
      aa_mut_gene      = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_gene"]]),
      aa_mut_structure = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_structure"]]),

      aa_mut_pos = {
        pos_val <- safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_pos"]])
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pos_val))
      },

      aa_mut_wt    = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_wt"]]),
      aa_mut_sub   = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_sub"]]),
      aa_mut_class = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_class"]]),
      aa_mut_ham   = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_ham"]]),

      phix_aa_mut_ham = {
        x <- .data[["phix_aa_mut_ham"]]
        x <- x[!is.na(x)]
        paste0(unique(x), collapse = ",")
      },

      phix_aa_mut_orf_class = "Synonymous",

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  message(
    "Synonymous mutation-level processing complete:\n",
    "  Total synonymous mutations: ", nrow(result), "\n",
    "  n = 1 mutations: ", sum(result[[out_n_col]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n",
    "  n > 1 mutations: ", sum(result[[out_n_col]] > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  return(result)
}



# Function to collapse for non-Synonymous mutation-level fitness
# Error is propagated measurement error SEM
unique_aa_mut_ID_protein_fitness <- function(
  df,
  fitness_col = "fitness_final_unique",
  sigma_col   = "sigma_final_unique",
  out_mean_col = "fitness_aa_mut",
  out_sd_background_col  = "SD_background",
  out_sem_background_col = "SEM_background",
  out_sem_col  = "sem_aa_mut",
  out_n_col    = "aa_mut_background_count"
) {

  library(dplyr)

  # ---- Checks ----
  if (!"aa_mut_ID" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("Missing 'aa_mut_ID' column")
  }

  if (!fitness_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Missing fitness column:", fitness_col))
  }

  if (!sigma_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Missing sigma column:", sigma_col))
  }

  # ---- Ensure optional metadata columns exist ----
  optional_cols <- c(
    "aa_mut_seq",
    "aa_mut_gene",
    "aa_mut_structure",
    "aa_mut_pos",
    "aa_mut_wt",
    "aa_mut_sub",
    "aa_mut_class",
    "aa_mut_ham",
    "phix_aa_mut_ham",
    "phix_aa_mut_orf_class"
  )

  for (col in optional_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) {
      df[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }

  # ---- Summarise ----
  result <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[["aa_mut_ID"]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[["aa_mut_ID"]]) %>%

    # Prefer phix_aa_mut_ham == 1 backgrounds when available.
    # If no preferred background exists, keep all backgrounds.
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_preferred = !is.na(.data[["phix_aa_mut_ham"]]) &
        .data[["phix_aa_mut_ham"]] == 1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_preferred | !any(is_preferred)) %>%

    dplyr::summarise(

      # ---- background count ----
      # Count retained backgrounds with non-missing fitness.
      !!out_n_col := sum(!is.na(.data[[fitness_col]])),

      # ---- amino-acid-level fitness ----
      # Arithmetic mean across retained backgrounds.
      !!out_mean_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        if (all(is.na(f))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          mean(f, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      },

      # ---- descriptive background SD ----
      !!out_sd_background_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        f <- f[!is.na(f)]

        if (length(f) > 1) {
          sd(f)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },

      # ---- descriptive background SEM ----
      !!out_sem_background_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        f <- f[!is.na(f)]

        if (length(f) > 1) {
          sd(f) / sqrt(length(f))
        } else {
          NA_real_
        }
      },

      # ---- propagated measurement-level SEM ----
      # This is the SEM used for downstream statistical testing.
      # Formula: sqrt(sum(sigma_i^2)) / n
      !!out_sem_col := {
        f <- .data[[fitness_col]]
        s <- .data[[sigma_col]]

        keep <- !is.na(f)
        s <- s[keep]

        n_eff <- length(s)

        if (n_eff == 0) {
          NA_real_
        } else if (any(is.na(s))) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          sqrt(sum(s^2)) / n_eff
        }
      },

      # ---- metadata ----
      aa_mut_seq       = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_seq"]]),
      aa_mut_gene      = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_gene"]]),
      aa_mut_structure = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_structure"]]),

      aa_mut_pos = {
        pos_val <- safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_pos"]])
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pos_val))
      },

      aa_mut_wt        = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_wt"]]),
      aa_mut_sub       = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_sub"]]),
      aa_mut_class     = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_class"]]),
      aa_mut_ham       = safe_first_non_na(.data[["aa_mut_ham"]]),

      phix_aa_mut_ham = {
        x <- .data[["phix_aa_mut_ham"]]
        x <- x[!is.na(x)]
        paste0(unique(x), collapse = ",")
      },

      phix_aa_mut_orf_class = safe_first_non_na(.data[["phix_aa_mut_orf_class"]]),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Processing summary ----
  total_mut <- nrow(result)
  n_single  <- sum(result[[out_n_col]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_multi   <- sum(result[[out_n_col]] > 1, na.rm = TRUE)

  message(
    "Mutation-level processing complete:\n",
    "  Total mutations: ", total_mut, "\n",
    "  n = 1 mutations: ", n_single, "\n",
    "  n > 1 mutations: ", n_multi
  )

  return(result)
}




# Function to run statistic tests and mutation category
# Two-samples t-test
two_samples_ttest <- function(mu1, sem1, n1, mu2, sem2, n2) {
  # Compute t-statistic using SEM directly
  t_stat <- (mu1 - mu2) / sqrt(sem1^2 + sem2^2)

  # Compute degrees of freedom (Welch’s approximation)
  df <- (sem1^2 + sem2^2)^2 /
        ((sem1^4 / (n1 - 1)) + (sem2^4 / (n2 - 1)))

  # Ensure df is valid
  if (is.na(df) || df <= 0) {
    df <- 1  # Prevent invalid df values
  }

  # Compute two-tailed p-value
  p_val <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_stat), df))

  return(p_val)
}



# Function to assign multiple rules for mutation category (20260224 updated)
assign_mutation_categories_fdr <- function(
  df,
  pval_col,
  effect_raw_col,
  alpha = 0.05,
  effect_breaks = c(0.10, 0.15, 0.50),

  effect_bin_col,
  category_fdr_col,
  category_fdr_lethal_col,
  category_cutoff_col,
  category_combined_col,

  direction_col,
  direction_lethal_col
) {

  # ---- Checks ----
  required_cols <- c(pval_col, effect_raw_col)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (!is.numeric(effect_breaks)) {
    stop("effect_breaks must be numeric.")
  }

  if (length(effect_breaks) != 3) {
    stop("effect_breaks should contain three values, e.g. c(0.10, 0.15, 0.50).")
  }

  effect_breaks <- sort(effect_breaks)

  # ---- Extract clean numeric vectors ----
  p <- as.numeric(df[[pval_col]])
  e <- as.numeric(df[[effect_raw_col]])

  # ---- Significance ----
  sig_flag <- !is.na(p) & (p < alpha)

  # ---- Base classification ----
  # Original category labels are kept:
  # Beneficial / Neutral / Detrimental
  category_fdr <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) | is.na(e) ~ NA_character_,
    !sig_flag ~ "Neutral",
    e > 0 ~ "Beneficial",
    e < 0 ~ "Detrimental",
    TRUE ~ "Neutral"
  )

  # ---- Effect bins ----
  effect_bin_num <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(e) ~ NA_real_,
    !sig_flag ~ 0,
    abs(e) >= effect_breaks[3] ~ effect_breaks[3],
    abs(e) >= effect_breaks[2] ~ effect_breaks[2],
    abs(e) >= effect_breaks[1] ~ effect_breaks[1],
    TRUE ~ 0
  )

  # ---- Lethal override ----
  category_fdr_lethal <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(category_fdr) ~ NA_character_,
    category_fdr == "Detrimental" &
      effect_bin_num >= effect_breaks[3] ~ "Lethal",
    TRUE ~ category_fdr
  )

  # ---- Cutoff refinement ----
  # Original 0.15 cutoff refinement is kept.
  category_cutoff <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(category_fdr) ~ NA_character_,
    category_fdr %in% c("Beneficial", "Detrimental") &
      effect_bin_num < effect_breaks[2] ~ "Neutral",
    category_fdr == "Detrimental" &
      effect_bin_num >= effect_breaks[3] ~ "Lethal",
    TRUE ~ category_fdr
  )

  # ---- Combined ----
  category_combined <- dplyr::case_when(
    category_cutoff %in% c("Beneficial", "Neutral") ~ "Tolerated",
    category_cutoff %in% c("Detrimental", "Lethal") ~ "Deleterious",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # ---- Direction column without lethal ----
  # Same logic as category_fdr, but with less interpretive labels.
  direction <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(category_fdr) ~ NA_character_,
    category_fdr == "Beneficial" ~ "Fitness-increasing",
    category_fdr == "Neutral" ~ "Neutral",
    category_fdr == "Detrimental" ~ "Fitness-decreasing",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # ---- Direction column with lethal ----
  # Same logic as category_fdr_lethal, but with less interpretive labels.
  direction_lethal <- dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(category_fdr_lethal) ~ NA_character_,
    category_fdr_lethal == "Beneficial" ~ "Fitness-increasing",
    category_fdr_lethal == "Neutral" ~ "Neutral",
    category_fdr_lethal == "Detrimental" ~ "Fitness-decreasing",
    category_fdr_lethal == "Lethal" ~ "Lethal",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  # ---- Safe overwrite ----
  output_cols <- c(
    effect_bin_col,
    category_fdr_col,
    category_fdr_lethal_col,
    category_cutoff_col,
    category_combined_col,
    direction_col,
    direction_lethal_col
  )

  for (col in output_cols) {
    df[[col]] <- NULL
  }

  # ---- Assign outputs explicitly ----
  df[[effect_bin_col]] <- factor(
    effect_bin_num,
    levels = c(0, effect_breaks)
  )

  df[[category_fdr_col]] <- factor(
    category_fdr,
    levels = c("Beneficial", "Neutral", "Detrimental")
  )

  df[[category_fdr_lethal_col]] <- factor(
    category_fdr_lethal,
    levels = c("Beneficial", "Neutral", "Detrimental", "Lethal")
  )

  df[[category_cutoff_col]] <- factor(
    category_cutoff,
    levels = c("Beneficial", "Neutral", "Detrimental", "Lethal")
  )

  df[[category_combined_col]] <- factor(
    category_combined,
    levels = c("Tolerated", "Deleterious")
  )

  df[[direction_col]] <- factor(
    direction,
    levels = c("Fitness-increasing", "Neutral", "Fitness-decreasing")
  )

  df[[direction_lethal_col]] <- factor(
    direction_lethal,
    levels = c(
      "Fitness-increasing",
      "Neutral",
      "Fitness-decreasing",
      "Lethal"
    )
  )

  return(df)
}



# Function to process aa mut data to residues data and a summary table about the @@ and %% of essential residues under different definitions
process_dms_fitness_data_list <- function(df) {
  
  # Detect gene name safely
  gene_label <- unique(df$aa_mut_gene)
  if (length(gene_label) != 1) {
    gene_label <- paste(gene_label, collapse = "_")
  }
  
  df_final <- df %>%
    
    dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(aa_mut_wt, ",")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(aa_mut_wt != "*", aa_mut_sub != "*") %>%
    
    dplyr::group_by(
      aa_mut_pos,
      aa_mut_gene,
      aa_mut_structure,
      aa_mut_wt
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::summarise(
      
      # ------------------------
      # Mutation counts
      # ------------------------
      
      n_mutations_tested_single_orf =
        sum(aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_tested_multi_orf =
        sum(aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "multi_orf", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      n_mutations_tested =
        sum(aa_mut_class == "Missense", na.rm = TRUE),

      # --- category counts (all) ---
      n_mutations_lethal =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Lethal" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_detrimental =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Detrimental" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_neutral =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Neutral" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_beneficial =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Beneficial" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense", na.rm = TRUE),

      # --- category counts (single_orf) ---
      n_mutations_lethal_single_orf =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Lethal" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_detrimental_single_orf =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Detrimental" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_neutral_single_orf =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Neutral" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),

      n_mutations_beneficial_single_orf =
        sum(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Beneficial" &
              aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),

      # ------------------------
      # Fitness summaries
      # ------------------------
      
      Fitness_mean =
        mean(fitness_aa_mut[aa_mut_class == "Missense"], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Fitness_median =
        median(fitness_aa_mut[aa_mut_class == "Missense"], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Fitness_mut_min =
        min(fitness_aa_mut[aa_mut_class == "Missense"], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Fitness_mut_max =
        max(fitness_aa_mut[aa_mut_class == "Missense"], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Fitness_mut_sd =
        sd(fitness_aa_mut[aa_mut_class == "Missense"], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      Fitness_mut_range =
        Fitness_mut_max - Fitness_mut_min,
      
      Fitness_mut_cv =
        ifelse(is.na(Fitness_mean) | Fitness_mean == 0,
               NA_real_,
               Fitness_mut_sd / Fitness_mean),

      # ------------------------
      # ORF logic
      # ------------------------
      
      has_single_orf =
        any(phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      residue_essential_FDR = dplyr::case_when(
        !has_single_orf ~ "Unable to define",
        any(mutation_category_FDR_1aa == "Detrimental" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Essential",
        TRUE ~ "Non-essential"
      ),
      
      residue_essential_FDR_lethal = dplyr::case_when(
        !has_single_orf ~ "Unable to define",
        any(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Lethal" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Essential",
        TRUE ~ "Non-essential"
      ),
      
      residue_essential_FDR_deleterious = dplyr::case_when(
        !has_single_orf ~ "Unable to define",
        any(mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_1aa_combined == "Deleterious" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Essential",
        TRUE ~ "Non-essential"
      ),
      
      
      # ------------------------
      # ORF logic (UPDATED)
      # ------------------------
      
      #has_single_orf =
        #any(phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      has_lethal_single_orf =
        any(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Lethal" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      has_detrimental_single_orf =
        any(mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa == "Detrimental" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      n_single_orf_mut =
        sum(aa_mut_class == "Missense" &
              phix_aa_mut_orf_class == "single_orf", na.rm = TRUE),
      
      is_fully_sampled =
        n_single_orf_mut == 19,
      
      coverage_fraction =
        n_single_orf_mut / 19,
      
      # ------------------------
      # Final residue classification (NEW)
      # ------------------------
      
      residue_category = dplyr::case_when(
        
        # no usable mutations
        !has_single_orf ~ "Unable to define",
        
        # strongest signal
        has_lethal_single_orf ~ "Essential",
        
        # sub-lethal signal
        !has_lethal_single_orf & has_detrimental_single_orf ~ "Sensitive",
        
        # only safe tolerance call
        !has_lethal_single_orf & 
          !has_detrimental_single_orf & 
          is_fully_sampled ~ "Tolerant",
        
        # everything else = incomplete information
        TRUE ~ "Unable to define"
      ),
           
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    
    # ------------------------
    # Ratios (derived from counts)
    # ------------------------
    
    dplyr::mutate(
      
      ratio_lethal =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_lethal / n_mutations_tested),
      
      ratio_detrimental =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_detrimental / n_mutations_tested),
      
      ratio_neutral =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_neutral / n_mutations_tested),
      
      ratio_beneficial =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_beneficial / n_mutations_tested),
      
      ratio_loss_total =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested == 0, NA_real_,
               (n_mutations_lethal + n_mutations_detrimental) / n_mutations_tested),
      
      ratio_lethal_single_orf =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested_single_orf == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_lethal_single_orf / n_mutations_tested_single_orf),
      
      ratio_detrimental_single_orf =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested_single_orf == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_detrimental_single_orf / n_mutations_tested_single_orf),
      
      ratio_neutral_single_orf =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested_single_orf == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_neutral_single_orf / n_mutations_tested_single_orf),
      
      ratio_beneficial_single_orf =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested_single_orf == 0, NA_real_,
               n_mutations_beneficial_single_orf / n_mutations_tested_single_orf),
      
      ratio_loss_total_single_orf =
        ifelse(n_mutations_tested_single_orf == 0, NA_real_,
               (n_mutations_lethal_single_orf + n_mutations_detrimental_single_orf) /
               n_mutations_tested_single_orf)
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::mutate(
      
      residue_essential_median_fitness =
        ifelse(Fitness_median < 0.5, "Essential", "Non-essential"),
      
      evolving_potential = ratio_neutral + ratio_beneficial,
      
      # ------------------------
      # Hotspot classification (NEW)
      # ------------------------
      
      hotspot_category_num_lethal = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(n_mutations_lethal) ~ NA_character_,
        n_mutations_lethal <= 11  ~ "Low (< median)",
        n_mutations_lethal <= 16  ~ "Moderate (median–Q3)",
        n_mutations_lethal > 16   ~ "Hotspot (≥ Q3)"
      ),
      
      hotspot_category_num_lethal = factor(
        hotspot_category_num_lethal,
        levels = c(
          "Low (< median)",
          "Moderate (median–Q3)",
          "Hotspot (≥ Q3)"
        )
      ),
      
      hotspot_category_num_lethal_single_orf = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(n_mutations_lethal_single_orf) ~ NA_character_,
        n_mutations_lethal_single_orf <= 11  ~ "Low (< median)",
        n_mutations_lethal_single_orf <= 16  ~ "Moderate (median–Q3)",
        n_mutations_lethal_single_orf > 16   ~ "Hotspot (≥ Q3)"
      ),
      
      hotspot_category_num_lethal_single_orf = factor(
        hotspot_category_num_lethal_single_orf,
        levels = c(
          "Low (< median)",
          "Moderate (median–Q3)",
          "Hotspot (≥ Q3)"
        )
      ),
      
      hotspot_category_quartile_fitness_median = dplyr::case_when(
        Fitness_median > 0.42751458   ~ "Non-hotspot",
        Fitness_median <= 0.42751458  ~ "Hotspot"
      ),
      
      hotspot_category_quartile_fitness_median = factor(
        hotspot_category_quartile_fitness_median,
        levels = c(
          "Non-hotspot",
          "Hotspot"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(-has_single_orf)
  
  # ----------------------------
  # Summary table (UNCHANGED)
  # ----------------------------
  
  total_residues <- nrow(df_final)
  
  make_summary_block <- function(col) {
    c(
      essential_n = sum(df_final[[col]] == "Essential", na.rm = TRUE),
      nonessential_n = sum(df_final[[col]] == "Non-essential", na.rm = TRUE),
      undefined_n = sum(df_final[[col]] == "Unable to define", na.rm = TRUE),
      essential_prop = mean(df_final[[col]] == "Essential", na.rm = TRUE),
      nonessential_prop = mean(df_final[[col]] == "Non-essential", na.rm = TRUE),
      undefined_prop = mean(df_final[[col]] == "Unable to define", na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
  
  summary_FDR    <- make_summary_block("residue_essential_FDR")
  summary_lethal <- make_summary_block("residue_essential_FDR_lethal")
  summary_del    <- make_summary_block("residue_essential_FDR_deleterious")
  
  summary_median <- c(
    essential_n = sum(df_final$residue_essential_median_fitness == "Essential"),
    nonessential_n = sum(df_final$residue_essential_median_fitness == "Non-essential"),
    undefined_n = NA,
    essential_prop = mean(df_final$residue_essential_median_fitness == "Essential"),
    nonessential_prop = mean(df_final$residue_essential_median_fitness == "Non-essential"),
    undefined_prop = NA
  )
  
  summary_category <- c(
    essential_n = sum(df_final$residue_category == "Essential", na.rm = TRUE),
    sensitive_n = sum(df_final$residue_category == "Sensitive", na.rm = TRUE),
    tolerant_n = sum(df_final$residue_category == "Tolerant", na.rm = TRUE),
    undefined_n = sum(df_final$residue_category == "Unable to define", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    essential_prop = mean(df_final$residue_category == "Essential", na.rm = TRUE),
    sensitive_prop = mean(df_final$residue_category == "Sensitive", na.rm = TRUE),
    tolerant_prop = mean(df_final$residue_category == "Tolerant", na.rm = TRUE),
    undefined_prop = mean(df_final$residue_category == "Unable to define", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  summary_df <- dplyr::tibble(
    gene = gene_label,
    total_residues = total_residues,
    
    FDR_essential_n = summary_FDR["essential_n"],
    FDR_nonessential_n = summary_FDR["nonessential_n"],
    FDR_undefined_n = summary_FDR["undefined_n"],
    FDR_essential_prop = summary_FDR["essential_prop"],
    FDR_nonessential_prop = summary_FDR["nonessential_prop"],
    FDR_undefined_prop = summary_FDR["undefined_prop"],
    
    lethal_essential_n = summary_lethal["essential_n"],
    lethal_nonessential_n = summary_lethal["nonessential_n"],
    lethal_undefined_n = summary_lethal["undefined_n"],
    lethal_essential_prop = summary_lethal["essential_prop"],
    lethal_nonessential_prop = summary_lethal["nonessential_prop"],
    lethal_undefined_prop = summary_lethal["undefined_prop"],
    
    deleterious_essential_n = summary_del["essential_n"],
    deleterious_nonessential_n = summary_del["nonessential_n"],
    deleterious_undefined_n = summary_del["undefined_n"],
    deleterious_essential_prop = summary_del["essential_prop"],
    deleterious_nonessential_prop = summary_del["nonessential_prop"],
    deleterious_undefined_prop = summary_del["undefined_prop"],
    
    category_essential_n = summary_category["essential_n"],
    category_sensitive_n = summary_category["sensitive_n"],
    category_tolerant_n = summary_category["tolerant_n"],
    category_undefined_n = summary_category["undefined_n"],
    
    category_essential_prop = summary_category["essential_prop"],
    category_sensitive_prop = summary_category["sensitive_prop"],
    category_tolerant_prop = summary_category["tolerant_prop"],
    category_undefined_prop = summary_category["undefined_prop"],

    median_essential_n = summary_median["essential_n"],
    median_nonessential_n = summary_median["nonessential_n"],
    median_essential_prop = summary_median["essential_prop"],
    median_nonessential_prop = summary_median["nonessential_prop"]
  )
  
  return(list(
    residue_table = df_final,
    summary_table = summary_df
  ))
}

# Add AA_classification based on priority rules

  aa == "*" ~ "Stop",
  
  charge_property == "positive" ~ "Positively_charged",
  charge_property == "negative" ~ "Negatively_charged",
  
  side_chain_property == "aromatic" ~ "Aromatic",   # <-- ADD THIS

  TRUE ~ "Other"
))

table(aa_property_table$AA_group_class)


# Function to supplement amino acid properties
add_aa_properties <- function(
  df,
  wt_col = "aa_mut_wt",
  sub_col = "aa_mut_sub",
  add_mutation_features = TRUE,
  add_special_flags = TRUE
) {

  # ---- Checks ----
  if (!wt_col %in% colnames(df)) {
    stop("wt_col not found in dataframe")
  }

  # ---- AA property table (ASSUMED precomputed with improved AA_group_class) ----
  aa_props <- aa_property_table %>%
    dplyr::select(
      aa,
      name,
      full_name,
      hydro_property,
      polarity_property,
      charge_property,
      side_chain_property,
      #AA_classification,
      AA_group_class
    )

  # ---- 1. Add WT properties ----
  df_annotated <- df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      aa_props,
      by = setNames("aa", wt_col)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      wt_name = name,
      wt_full_name = full_name,
      wt_hydro_property = hydro_property,
      wt_polarity_property = polarity_property,
      wt_charge_property = charge_property,
      wt_side_chain_property = side_chain_property,
      #wt_AA_classification = AA_classification,
      wt_AA_group_class = AA_group_class
    )

  # ---- 2. Add SUB properties ----
  if (sub_col %in% colnames(df)) {

    df_annotated <- df_annotated %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        aa_props,
        by = setNames("aa", sub_col)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        sub_name = name,
        sub_full_name = full_name,
        sub_hydro_property = hydro_property,
        sub_polarity_property = polarity_property,
        sub_charge_property = charge_property,
        sub_side_chain_property = side_chain_property,
        #sub_AA_classification = AA_classification,
        sub_AA_group_class = AA_group_class
      )

    # ---- 3. Mutation features ----
    if (add_mutation_features) {

      df_annotated <- df_annotated %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          aa_mutation_hydro =
            paste0(wt_hydro_property, "_to_", sub_hydro_property),

          aa_mutation_polarity =
            paste0(wt_polarity_property, "_to_", sub_polarity_property),

          aa_mutation_charge =
            paste0(wt_charge_property, "_to_", sub_charge_property),

          aa_mutation_class =
            paste0(wt_AA_group_class, "_to_", sub_AA_group_class),

          aa_mutation_type =
            paste0(
              wt_AA_group_class, "_to_", sub_AA_group_class, ";",
              wt_charge_property, "_to_", sub_charge_property, ";",
              wt_polarity_property, "_to_", sub_polarity_property, ";",
              wt_hydro_property, "_to_", sub_hydro_property
            )
        )
    }

    # ---- 4. Special residue flags (VERY useful for DMS) ----
    if (add_special_flags) {

      df_annotated <- df_annotated %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          is_aromatic =
            wt_side_chain_property == "aromatic" |
            sub_side_chain_property == "aromatic",

          is_glycine =
            .data[[wt_col]] == "G" | .data[[sub_col]] == "G",

          is_proline =
            .data[[wt_col]] == "P" | .data[[sub_col]] == "P",

          is_cysteine =
            .data[[wt_col]] == "C" | .data[[sub_col]] == "C"
        )
    }
  }

  return(df_annotated)
}



# Function to combine secondary structural annotations
combine_secondary_structure <- function(df, combined_col = "secondary_structure_ss") {
  library(dplyr)
  
  # 1. Identify *_ssdraw columns
  ss_cols <- df %>% select(ends_with("_ssdraw")) %>% names()
  
  if (length(ss_cols) == 0) {
    warning("No *_ssdraw columns found. Skipping combination.")
    return(df)
  }
  
  # 2. If only one *_ssdraw column, copy directly
  if (length(ss_cols) == 1) {
    df[[combined_col]] <- df[[ss_cols[1]]]
  } else {
    # Priority map (lower = higher priority)
    priority <- c("helix" = 1, "sheet" = 2, "coil" = 3, "unknown" = 4)
    
    df[[combined_col]] <- apply(df[ss_cols], 1, function(row) {
      ss_vals <- na.omit(as.character(row))
      ss_vals <- ss_vals[ss_vals %in% names(priority)]
      if (length(ss_vals) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      ss_vals[which.min(priority[ss_vals])]
    })
  }
  
  # 3. Annotate segments and per-type numbering, excluding NA
  ss_vec <- df[[combined_col]]
  
  # Handle NA safely: mask them during numbering
  is_valid <- !is.na(ss_vec)
  
  segment_index <- rep(NA_integer_, length(ss_vec))
  ss_serial <- rep(NA_integer_, length(ss_vec))
  
  if (any(is_valid)) {
    # Run-length encode only valid regions
    r <- rle(ss_vec[is_valid])
    
    seg_idx <- seq_along(r$lengths)
    seg_rep <- rep(seg_idx, times = r$lengths)
    
    # Assign segment indices back to valid positions
    segment_index[is_valid] <- seg_rep
    
    # Per-type numbering (helix1, sheet1, etc.)
    idx_valid <- which(is_valid)
    per_type_counter <- list()
    for (i in seq_along(idx_valid)) {
      val <- ss_vec[idx_valid[i]]
      if (!is.null(per_type_counter[[val]])) {
        # Increment if new segment (based on previous element)
        if (i == 1 || ss_vec[idx_valid[i - 1]] != val)
          per_type_counter[[val]] <- per_type_counter[[val]] + 1
      } else {
        per_type_counter[[val]] <- 1
      }
      ss_serial[idx_valid[i]] <- per_type_counter[[val]]
    }
  }
  
  # 4. Construct label safely
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      ss_segment_index = segment_index,
      ss_serial = ss_serial,
      ss_label = ifelse(is.na(secondary_structure_ss), NA_character_,
                        paste0(secondary_structure_ss, ss_serial))
    )
  
  return(df)
}


# Function to merge the PPI data.frames under lists with Fitness Data
merge_mut_ppi_list <- function(base_df, df_names_vector, mut_suffix = "") {
  # Dynamically build the column name
  by_col <- paste0("gene_sub_aa_mut", mut_suffix, "_pos")
  
  merged_df <- base_df
  
  for (df_name in df_names_vector) {
    if (exists(df_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      df_to_merge <- get(df_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      merged_df <- merge(merged_df, df_to_merge, by = by_col, all.x = TRUE)
      cat("Merged with:", df_name, "\n")
    } else {
      cat("Skipping:", df_name, "- Data frame not found\n")
    }
  }
  
  return(merged_df)
}


# Function to combine PPI annotations and clarify aa annotations
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine *_gene columns → binder_genes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
paste_binder_genes <- function(df, output_col = "binder_genes") {

  selected_cols <- names(df)[
    grepl("binder.*_gene", names(df)) &
    !grepl("RSASA", names(df))
  ]

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(!!output_col := {
      values <- dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(selected_cols))
      values <- unique(na.omit(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", values)))
      paste(sort(values), collapse = ",")
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  return(df)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine *_class columns → binder_classes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
paste_binder_classes <- function(df, output_col = "binder_classes") {

  selected_cols <- names(df)[
    grepl("binder.*_class", names(df)) &
    !grepl("RSASA", names(df))
  ]

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(!!output_col := {
      values <- dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(selected_cols))
      values <- unique(na.omit(values))
      paste(sort(values), collapse = ",")
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  return(df)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine *_complex columns → binder_complexes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
paste_binder_complexes <- function(df, output_col = "binder_complexes") {

  selected_cols <- names(df)[
    grepl("binder.*_complex", names(df)) &
    !grepl("RSASA", names(df))
  ]

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(!!output_col := {
      values <- dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(selected_cols))
      split_values <- unlist(strsplit(na.omit(values), ","))
      split_values <- trimws(split_values)
      values <- sort(unique(split_values[split_values != ""]))
      paste(values, collapse = ",")
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  return(df)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prioritize monomer structural class
# Rule: Surface > Core > Unknown
# ------------------------------------------------------------
paste_monomer_structural_class <- function(df, output_col = "monomer_structural_class") {

  selected_cols <- grep("_aa_monomer_class", colnames(df), value = TRUE)

  if (length(selected_cols) == 0) {
    df[[output_col]] <- NA_character_
    return(df)
  }

  priority_order <- c("Surface", "Core", "Unknown")

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(!!output_col := {
      unique_values <- unique(na.omit(dplyr::c_across(dplyr::all_of(selected_cols))))
      match_value <- priority_order[priority_order %in% unique_values][1]
      ifelse(is.na(match_value), NA_character_, match_value)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  return(df)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge binder + monomer info → structural_context
# Binder info overrides monomer class
# ------------------------------------------------------------
merge_structural_context <- function(
  df,
  binder_col = "binder_genes",
  monomer_col = "monomer_structural_class",
  output_col = "residue_structural_class"
) {

  df[[output_col]] <- ifelse(
    !is.na(df[[binder_col]]) & df[[binder_col]] != "",
    paste0("Bind-", df[[binder_col]]),
    df[[monomer_col]]
  )

  return(df)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Master function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
combine_protein_ppi_info <- function(df) {

  df %>%
    paste_binder_genes(output_col = "binder_genes") %>%
    paste_binder_classes(output_col = "binder_classes") %>%
    paste_binder_complexes(output_col = "binder_complexes") %>%
    paste_monomer_structural_class(output_col = "monomer_structural_class") %>%
    merge_structural_context(
      binder_col = "binder_genes",
      monomer_col = "monomer_structural_class",
      output_col = "residue_structural_class"
    )
}


# Function to supplement columns to plotting data.frames
clarify_aa_mut_features <- function(
  df,
  structural_col = "residue_structural_class",
  binding_type_col = "residue_binding_type",
  interaction_class_col = "residue_interaction_class",
  binder_genes_col = "binder_genes",
  binder_count_col = "binder_gene_count",
  structural_group_col = "residue_structural_group",
  monomer_structural_col = "monomer_structural_class",
  surface_class_col = "residue_surface_class"
) {
  
  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Add missing columns as NA to avoid pipeline stopping
  # -------------------------------------------------
  if (!binder_genes_col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[binder_genes_col]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  if (!structural_col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[structural_col]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  if (!monomer_structural_col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[monomer_structural_col]] <- NA_character_
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      
      # -------------------------------------------------
      # Detect PDI and PPI independently
      # Keep original logic
      # -------------------------------------------------
      has_pdi = grepl("Bind-.*DNA|DNA.*Bind-", .data[[structural_col]]),
      has_ppi = grepl("Bind-", .data[[structural_col]]) &
        !grepl("Bind-.*DNA|DNA.*Bind-", .data[[structural_col]]),
      
      # -------------------------------------------------
      # Combine binding types safely
      # -------------------------------------------------
      !!binding_type_col := dplyr::case_when(
        has_pdi & has_ppi ~ "PDI,PPI",
        has_pdi ~ "PDI",
        has_ppi ~ "PPI",
        TRUE ~ .data[[structural_col]]
      ),
      
      # -------------------------------------------------
      # Count binder genes
      # Keep original logic
      # -------------------------------------------------
      !!binder_count_col := ifelse(
        grepl("PPI", .data[[binding_type_col]]),
        sapply(.data[[binder_genes_col]], function(x) {
          if (is.na(x) || x == "") 0L
          else length(unique(unlist(strsplit(x, ","))))
        }),
        NA_integer_
      ),
      
      # -------------------------------------------------
      # New column: single vs multi interaction
      # Based only on binder_genes
      # -------------------------------------------------
      !!interaction_class_col := sapply(.data[[binder_genes_col]], function(x) {
        if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
          NA_character_
        } else {
          n_binders <- length(unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))))
          
          if (n_binders >= 2) {
            "Multi-interaction"
          } else if (n_binders == 1) {
            "Single-interaction"
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }
        }
      }),
      
      # -------------------------------------------------
      # Broader structural grouping
      # -------------------------------------------------
      !!structural_group_col := dplyr::case_when(
        .data[[binding_type_col]] == "Core" ~ "Core",
        grepl("PPI|PDI", .data[[binding_type_col]]) ~ "Interacting",
        .data[[binding_type_col]] == "Surface" ~ "Other Surface",
        .data[[binding_type_col]] == "Unknown" ~ "No Structure",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      # -------------------------------------------------
      # Refined surface class
      # -------------------------------------------------
      !!surface_class_col := dplyr::case_when(
        .data[[structural_group_col]] == "Interacting" ~ "Interacting",
        .data[[monomer_structural_col]] == "Surface" &
          .data[[structural_group_col]] != "Interacting" ~ "Other Surface",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-has_pdi, -has_ppi)
  
  return(df)
}


# Function to update monomer surface class
assign_surface_class <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      residue_surface_class = case_when(
        residue_structural_group == "Interacting"                                ~ "Interacting",
        monomer_structural_class == "Surface" & residue_structural_group != "Interacting"   ~ "Other Surface",
        TRUE                                                         ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Function to subset common columns from protein data.frames
# Mutation level
subset_common_proteome_columns_mut <- function(df, base_cols = base_columns_mut) {
  # Dynamically include all columns starting with 'wt_' or 'sub_'
  dynamic_columns <- grep("^(wt_|sub_)", names(df), value = TRUE)
  
  # Combine static and dynamic columns
  selected_columns <- c(base_cols, dynamic_columns)
  
  # Warn if base columns missing
  missing_cols <- setdiff(base_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning(
      "The following mutation-level columns are not found and will be skipped: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # Subset to columns that exist
  df_subset <- df[, intersect(selected_columns, names(df)), drop = FALSE]
  return(df_subset)
}


# Residue level
subset_common_proteome_columns_aa <- function(df, base_cols = base_columns_aa) {
  # Dynamically include columns starting with 'wt_'
  wt_property_columns <- grep("^wt_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  
  # Combine static and dynamic columns
  selected_columns <- c(base_cols, wt_property_columns)
  
  # Warn if base columns missing
  missing_cols <- setdiff(base_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning(
      "The following residue-level columns are not found and will be skipped: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # Subset to columns that exist
  df_subset <- df[, intersect(selected_columns, names(df)), drop = FALSE]
  return(df_subset)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to do Chi-square Test (with Cramér’s V)
run_chisq_test <- function(df,
                           group_col,
                           category_col,
                           dataset = NA,
                           gene = NA,
                           simulate_p = FALSE) {

  group_sym    <- rlang::ensym(group_col)
  category_sym <- rlang::ensym(category_col)

  dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!group_sym),
                  !is.na(!!category_sym))

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    stop("No complete cases available for chi-square test.")
  }

  tab <- table(dat[[rlang::as_name(group_sym)]],
               dat[[rlang::as_name(category_sym)]])

  test <- suppressWarnings(
    chisq.test(tab, simulate.p.value = simulate_p)
  )

  # Effect size: Cramér’s V
  cramer_v <- sqrt(as.numeric(test$statistic) /
                   (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1)))

  # Convert tables safely
  observed_df <- as.data.frame(tab)
  colnames(observed_df) <- c("group", "category", "observed")
  
  expected_df <- as.data.frame(test$expected)
  colnames(expected_df) <- c("group", "category", "expected")
  
  residual_df <- as.data.frame(test$stdres)
  colnames(residual_df) <- c("group", "category", "std_resid")

  summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
    test_type     = "chi_square",
    dataset       = dataset,
    gene          = gene,
    group_var     = rlang::as_name(group_sym),
    category_var  = rlang::as_name(category_sym),
    n_total       = sum(tab),
    statistic     = unname(test$statistic),
    df            = unname(test$parameter),
    p_value       = test$p.value,
    effect_size   = unname(cramer_v),
    effect_name   = "cramers_v",
    method        = test$method,
    min_expected  = min(test$expected)
  )

  return(list(
    summary   = summary_tbl,
    observed  = observed_df,
    expected  = expected_df,
    residuals = residual_df
  ))
}
```

Enrichment analysis
```{r}
# Function to run Odds Ratio Calculation
run_odds_ratio <- function(df,
                           exposure_col,
                           exposure_focus,
                           outcome_col,
                           outcome_focus,
                           dataset = NA,
                           group = NA) {

  exposure_sym <- rlang::ensym(exposure_col)
  outcome_sym  <- rlang::ensym(outcome_col)

  exposure_name <- rlang::as_name(exposure_sym)
  outcome_name  <- rlang::as_name(outcome_sym)

  dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_name]]),
                  !is.na(.data[[outcome_name]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      exposure = .data[[exposure_name]] == exposure_focus,
      outcome  = .data[[outcome_name]] %in% outcome_focus
    )

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    stop("No complete cases available.")
  }

  tab <- table(dat$exposure, dat$outcome)

  # If not 2x2, return NA row instead of stopping
  if (!all(dim(tab) == c(2, 2))) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      test_type   = "fisher_odds_ratio",
      dataset     = dataset,
      group       = group,
      exposure_var= exposure_name,
      outcome_var = outcome_name,
      exposure_focus = exposure_focus,
      outcome_focus  = paste(outcome_focus, collapse = ","),
      n_total     = sum(tab),
      a_exposed_outcome     = NA_integer_,
      b_exposed_no_outcome  = NA_integer_,
      c_unexp_outcome       = NA_integer_,
      d_unexp_no_outcome    = NA_integer_,
      odds_ratio  = NA_real_,
      conf_low    = NA_real_,
      conf_high   = NA_real_,
      log_or_ln   = NA_real_,
      log_or_log10= NA_real_,
      log_conf_low_ln    = NA_real_,
      log_conf_high_ln   = NA_real_,
      log_conf_low_log10 = NA_real_,
      log_conf_high_log10= NA_real_,
      p_value     = NA_real_,
      method      = "Not 2x2 — skipped"
    ))
  }

  ft <- fisher.test(tab)

  # Extract once
  or_val  <- unname(ft$estimate)
  ci_low  <- ft$conf.int[1]
  ci_high <- ft$conf.int[2]

  tibble::tibble(
    test_type   = "fisher_odds_ratio",
    dataset     = dataset,
    group       = group,
    exposure_var= exposure_name,
    outcome_var = outcome_name,
    exposure_focus = exposure_focus,
    outcome_focus  = paste(outcome_focus, collapse = ","),
    n_total     = sum(tab),
    a_exposed_outcome     = tab[2, 2],
    b_exposed_no_outcome  = tab[2, 1],
    c_unexp_outcome       = tab[1, 2],
    d_unexp_no_outcome    = tab[1, 1],
    odds_ratio  = or_val,
    conf_low    = ci_low,
    conf_high   = ci_high,

    # Natural log
    log_or_ln   = log(or_val),
    log_conf_low_ln  = log(ci_low),
    log_conf_high_ln = log(ci_high),

    # Log10
    log_or_log10     = log10(or_val),
    log_conf_low_log10  = log10(ci_low),
    log_conf_high_log10 = log10(ci_high),

    p_value     = ft$p.value,
    method      = ft$method
  )
}


# Function for grid runner
run_odds_ratio_grid <- function(df,
                               group_col = NULL,
                               exposure_col,
                               exposure_focuses,
                               outcome_col,
                               outcome_focus) {

  exposure_sym <- rlang::ensym(exposure_col)
  outcome_sym  <- rlang::ensym(outcome_col)

  # ---- helper: safe OR ----
  safe_or <- function(data, focus, group_value) {

    # filter complete cases
    data_use <- data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(!!exposure_sym),
        !is.na(!!outcome_sym)
      )

    # skip if no data
    if (nrow(data_use) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    # try safely
    tryCatch(
      run_odds_ratio(
        df = data_use,
        exposure_col = !!exposure_sym,
        exposure_focus = focus,
        outcome_col = !!outcome_sym,
        outcome_focus = outcome_focus,
        group = group_value
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        # optional message
        # message("Skipping group: ", group_value, " | focus: ", focus)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
  }

  # ---- Case 1: NO grouping ----
  if (is.null(group_col)) {

    return(
      purrr::map_dfr(exposure_focuses, function(focus) {
        safe_or(df, focus, "Proteome")
      })
    )
  }

  # ---- Case 2: WITH grouping ----
  group_sym  <- rlang::ensym(group_col)
  group_name <- rlang::as_name(group_sym)

  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[group_name]])) %>%
    dplyr::group_split(!!group_sym) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(function(subdf) {

      group_value <- subdf[[group_name]][1]

      purrr::map_dfr(exposure_focuses, function(focus) {
        safe_or(subdf, focus, group_value)
      })
    })
}




# Function for running odds ratio calculation in loops
run_or_pipeline <- function(dataset_list,
                            analysis_plan,
                            exposure_focus_list,
                            outcome_col,
                            outcome_focus,
                            group_col = NA) {

  purrr::pmap_dfr(analysis_plan, function(subset, exposure) {

    df_use <- dataset_list[[subset]]
    focuses <- exposure_focus_list[[exposure]]

    run_odds_ratio_grid(
      df = df_use,
      group_col = {{group_col}},
      exposure_col = !!rlang::sym(exposure),
      exposure_focuses = focuses,
      outcome_col = {{outcome_col}},
      outcome_focus = outcome_focus
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        subset = subset,
        exposure_set = exposure
      )
  })
}
```

```{r}
# Function to generate summary table
generate_mutation_category_summary <- function(
    df, 
    class_col,
    category_col,
    total_count = NULL
) {

  class_syms    <- rlang::syms(class_col)
  category_sym  <- rlang::ensym(category_col)

  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!category_sym)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!class_syms, !!category_sym) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(count = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!class_syms) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      proportion = if (is.null(total_count)) {
        count / sum(count)
      } else {
        count / total_count
      },
      percent = round(proportion * 100, 2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}


# Function to generate statistics results
run_fisher_from_summary <- function(summary_df,
                                    group_col,
                                    category_col,
                                    count_col = "count",
                                    test_category,
                                    reference_group = NULL,
                                    comparison_group = NULL,
                                    alternative = "two.sided") {
  
  group_col <- rlang::ensym(group_col)
  category_col <- rlang::ensym(category_col)
  count_col <- rlang::ensym(count_col)
  
  # ---- Collapse category into target vs other ----
  fisher_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(
      test_binary = ifelse(
        !!category_col == test_category,
        test_category,
        paste0("Non-", test_category)
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(!!group_col, test_binary) %>%
    summarise(
      count = sum(!!count_col, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # ---- Optionally restrict to two groups ----
  if (!is.null(reference_group) & !is.null(comparison_group)) {
    fisher_df <- fisher_df %>%
      filter(
        !!group_col %in% c(reference_group, comparison_group)
      )
  }
  
  # ---- Convert to 2 x 2 table ----
  fisher_table <- fisher_df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = test_binary,
      values_from = count,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames(rlang::as_string(group_col)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Make column order clear
  fisher_table <- fisher_table[, c(test_category, paste0("Non-", test_category))]
  
  # Make row order clear, if specified
  if (!is.null(reference_group) & !is.null(comparison_group)) {
    fisher_table <- fisher_table[c(comparison_group, reference_group), ]
  }
  
  # ---- Fisher's exact test ----
  fisher_result <- fisher.test(
    fisher_table,
    alternative = alternative
  )
  
  # ---- Output clean result ----
  result_df <- tibble(
    comparison_group = rownames(fisher_table)[1],
    reference_group = rownames(fisher_table)[2],
    test_category = test_category,
    comparison_target_count = fisher_table[1, test_category],
    comparison_other_count = fisher_table[1, paste0("Non-", test_category)],
    reference_target_count = fisher_table[2, test_category],
    reference_other_count = fisher_table[2, paste0("Non-", test_category)],
    comparison_percent = round(
      fisher_table[1, test_category] / sum(fisher_table[1, ]) * 100,
      2
    ),
    reference_percent = round(
      fisher_table[2, test_category] / sum(fisher_table[2, ]) * 100,
      2
    ),
    odds_ratio = unname(fisher_result$estimate),
    conf_low = fisher_result$conf.int[1],
    conf_high = fisher_result$conf.int[2],
    p_value = fisher_result$p.value
  )
  
  list(
    table = fisher_table,
    fisher_test = fisher_result,
    result = result_df
  )
}



## Function to summarise proportions
# 1) summarise fitness-reduced mutations [fraction of Reduced-fitness mutations]
generate_proportion_summary <- function(
    df,
    gene_col,
    structure_col,
    category_col,
    positive_classes,
    output_label = "positive"
) {

  gene_sym      <- rlang::sym(gene_col)
  structure_sym <- rlang::sym(structure_col)
  category_sym  <- rlang::sym(category_col)

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      target_class = dplyr::if_else(
        .data[[category_col]] %in% positive_classes,
        output_label,
        "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data[[gene_col]],
      .data[[structure_col]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_n = dplyr::n(),
      positive_n = sum(target_class == output_label, na.rm = TRUE),
      proportion = positive_n / total_n,
      percent = round(proportion * 100, 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


# 2) plotting table 
prepare_scatter_from_summary <- function(
    df,
    gene_col,
    class_col,
    value_col,
    classes = NULL,
    fill_missing = NA,
    agg_fun = NULL
) {

  # Ensure strings
  gene_col  <- as.character(gene_col)
  class_col <- as.character(class_col)
  value_col <- as.character(value_col)

  df_clean <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene = .data[[gene_col]],
      class = .data[[class_col]],
      value = .data[[value_col]]
    )

  # ---- Optional filtering of classes ----
  if (!is.null(classes)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>%
      dplyr::filter(class %in% classes)
  }

  # ---- Handle duplicates (important!) ----
  if (!is.null(agg_fun)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>%
      dplyr::group_by(gene, class) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        value = agg_fun(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }

  # ---- Pivot ----
  df_wide <- df_clean %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = class,
      values_from = value,
      values_fill = fill_missing
    )

  return(df_wide)
}
```
