```{r}
# Define AA properties
stop <- "*"
hydropho_armoa <- c("F", "W", "Y")
hydropho_nonpolar_alipha <- c("P", "M", "I", "L", "V", "A", "G")  # A, G are small
hydrophil_polar_uncharg <- c("C", "S", "T", "N", "Q")
hydrophil_negat <- c("D", "E")
hydrophil_posti <- c("H", "K", "R")
# Define overall amino acid level order
aas <- c(stop, hydropho_armoa, hydropho_nonpolar_alipha, hydrophil_polar_uncharg, hydrophil_negat, hydrophil_posti)


# Function to prepare data.frames for Heatmaps
prepare_protein_heatmap_cols <- function(df,
                                         pos_col = "aa_mut_pos",
                                         wt_col  = "aa_mut_wt",
                                         sub_col = "aa_mut_sub",
                                         id_col  = "aa_mut_ID",
                                         value_col = "fitness_final_unique",
                                         orf_col = "phix_aa_mut_orf_class") {
  # Remove all columns starting with 'gp' (case-sensitive)
  df_filtered <- df %>%
    select(-matches("^gp"))
  
  # Select and rename key columns while preserving all others
  df_clean <- df_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      pos     = .data[[pos_col]],
      wt      = .data[[wt_col]],
      sub     = .data[[sub_col]],
      id      = .data[[id_col]],
      fitness = .data[[value_col]],
      orf     = .data[[orf_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(sub != "syn", !is.na(pos)) %>%
    mutate(
      wt  = factor(wt, levels = aas),
      sub = factor(sub, levels = aas)
    )

  # Move the key columns to the front for clarity
  df_clean <- df_clean %>%
    relocate(pos, wt, sub, id, fitness, orf, .before = 1)

  # Report summary info
  message("Number of rows in cleaned heatmap data: ", nrow(df_clean))
  message("Number of columns kept: ", ncol(df_clean))

  return(df_clean)
}



# Function to plot binary heatmap 
plot_heatmap_binary_class <- function(data,
                                      pos_col = "pos",
                                      class_col = "Class",
                                      value_col = "Value",
                                      plot_title = "",
                                      show_legend = FALSE,
                                      show_title = FALSE,
                                      x_tick_step = 10,
                                      x_label = "Position",
                                      y_label = "Class",
                                      core_color = "#a6b6c7",
                                      interface_color = "#aac6b0",
                                      
                                      #core_color = "black",
                                      #interface_color = "black",
                                      absent_color = "gray95") {
  
  # Convert to symbols
  pos_sym   <- rlang::sym(pos_col)
  class_sym <- rlang::sym(class_col)
  val_sym   <- rlang::sym(value_col)
  
  # Generate x-axis breaks
  x_breaks <- sort(unique(data[[pos_col]]))
  x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks %% x_tick_step == 0]
  
  # Create plotting fill class
  plot_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fill_class = dplyr::case_when(
        !!class_sym == "Core" & !!val_sym > 0 ~ "Core",
        !!class_sym == "Interface" & !!val_sym > 0 ~ "Interface",
        is.na(!!val_sym) ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ "Absent"
      ),
      fill_class = factor(
        fill_class,
        levels = c("Interface", "Core", "Absent")
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = !!pos_sym,
      y = !!class_sym,
      fill = fill_class
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_fixed() +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      breaks = x_breaks
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Interface" = interface_color,
        "Core" = core_color,
        "Absent" = absent_color
      ),
      na.value = "white",
      name = "Class",
      guide = if (show_legend) guide_legend(
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      ) else "none"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  if (show_title) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(plot_title)
  }
  
  p <- p + xlab(x_label) + ylab(y_label)
  
  return(p)
}



# Function - Density plot function
plot_ridgeline_mut_class <- function(
  data,
  score_col = fitness_final,             # numeric variable on x-axis
  class_col = phix_aa_mut_class,         # class/category on y-axis
  group_col = NULL,                      # optional facet variable
  y_order = NULL,                        # manual order for y-axis
  group_order = NULL,                    # manual order for facet variable
  plot_title = "Ridgeline Density Plot of Fitness Final",
  x_label = "Fitness",
  y_label = "Class"
) {
  # ---- Capture tidy eval symbols ----
  score_sym <- rlang::ensym(score_col)
  class_sym <- rlang::ensym(class_col)
  group_sym <- if (!is.null(group_col)) rlang::ensym(group_col) else NULL

  # ---- Apply manual y-axis order ----
  if (!is.null(y_order)) {
    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!class_sym := factor(.data[[rlang::as_name(class_sym)]],
                              levels = y_order)
      )
  }

  # ---- Apply manual facet (group) order ----
  if (!is.null(group_col) && !is.null(group_order)) {
    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!group_sym := factor(.data[[rlang::as_name(group_sym)]],
                              levels = group_order)
      )
  }

  # ---- Build base ridgeline plot ----
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = !!score_sym, y = !!class_sym)) +
    ggridges::geom_density_ridges(
      scale = 1.2,
      fill = "grey80",
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.8,
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::xlim(-1, 1.5) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  # ---- Add faceting if group_col is provided ----
  if (!is.null(group_col)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ggplot2::vars(!!group_sym),
      scales = "free_x",
      nrow = 1
    )
  }

  return(p)
}



# Function to plot the Odds ratio (raw values, natural scale)
plot_forest_or_raw <- function(
  data,
  label_col,
  or_col,
  low_col,
  high_col,
  p_col = NULL,
  facet_col = NULL,
  title = "Odds Ratio",
  ref_line = 1,
  or_ticks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
  point_size = 2,
  ci_width = 0.6,
  star_size = 4,
  star_offset = 0.05
) {

  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)

  # ---- Build dataframe ----
  df <- data.frame(
    label = data[[label_col]],
    or    = data[[or_col]],
    low   = data[[low_col]],
    high  = data[[high_col]]
  )

  if (!is.null(p_col) && p_col %in% names(data)) {
    df$pval <- data[[p_col]]
  }

  if (!is.null(facet_col) && facet_col %in% names(data)) {
    df$facet <- data[[facet_col]]
  }

  # ---- Critical filtering for log scale ----
  df <- df[
    is.finite(df$or) &
    is.finite(df$low) &
    is.finite(df$high) &
    df$or > 0 &
    df$low > 0 &
    df$high > 0,
  ]

  # ---- Order ----
  df <- df %>% arrange(desc(or))
  df$label <- factor(df$label, levels = rev(unique(df$label)))

  # ---- Stars (robust) ----
  if (!is.null(p_col) && "pval" %in% names(df) && length(df$pval) == nrow(df)) {

    df$star <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(df$pval)   ~ "",
      df$pval <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      df$pval <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      df$pval <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )

  } else {
    df$star <- rep("", nrow(df))
  }

  # ---- Star positions ----
  df$star_x <- df$high * (1 + star_offset)

  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = or, y = label)) +
    
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_line, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = low, xmax = high),
      width = 0,
      linewidth = ci_width
    ) +
    
    geom_point(size = point_size) +

    # ---- LOG SCALE ----
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = or_ticks,
      labels = or_ticks
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Odds Ratio (log scale)",
      y = NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    
    theme_classic()

  # ---- Add stars ----
  if (!is.null(p_col)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text(
        aes(x = star_x, label = star),
        hjust = 0,
        size = star_size,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      expand_limits(x = max(df$star_x, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2)
  }

  # ---- Facet ----
  if (!is.null(facet_col) && "facet" %in% names(df)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~facet)
  }

  return(p)
}




# Function - Stacked Barplot to show percentage of factors (add order column, remove hardcoding rules)
# 1) Mutations Category
bar_percent_stacked_proteome <- function(
    summary_df,
    class_col = Class,
    category_col = Category,
    count_col = count,
    percent_col = percent,
    plot_title = "Mutation Category by Class",
    fill_legend_title = "Mutation Category",
    x_order = NULL,
    facet_col = NULL,
    stat_df = NULL,
    stat_p_col = "p_value",
    stat_group_col = NULL,
    stat_format = c("p", "stars"),
    stat_position = c("subtitle", "caption", "none")
) {

  stat_format   <- match.arg(stat_format)
  stat_position <- match.arg(stat_position)

  # ---- Symbols ----
  class_sym    <- rlang::ensym(class_col)
  category_sym <- rlang::ensym(category_col)
  count_sym    <- rlang::ensym(count_col)
  percent_sym  <- rlang::ensym(percent_col)
  facet_sym    <- if (!is.null(facet_col)) rlang::ensym(facet_col) else NULL

  class_name    <- rlang::as_name(class_sym)
  category_name <- rlang::as_name(category_sym)
  percent_name  <- rlang::as_name(percent_sym)

  # ---- Clean & Aggregate ----
  grouping_vars <- if (is.null(facet_sym)) {
    list(class_sym, category_sym)
  } else {
    list(facet_sym, class_sym, category_sym)
  }

  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!class_sym), !is.na(!!category_sym)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!grouping_vars) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      !!count_sym := sum(!!count_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Recompute percentages ----
  group_class_vars <- if (is.null(facet_sym)) {
    list(class_sym)
  } else {
    list(facet_sym, class_sym)
  }

  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!group_class_vars) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      !!percent_sym := round(
        !!count_sym / sum(!!count_sym) * 100, 2
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # ---- Compute total counts per bar ----
  total_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!group_class_vars) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_count = sum(!!count_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Category order ----
  summary_df[[category_name]] <- factor(
    summary_df[[category_name]],
    levels = c("Beneficial", "Neutral", "Detrimental", "Lethal"),
    ordered = TRUE
  )

  # ---- Ordering ----
  if (!is.null(x_order)) {

    summary_df <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(!!class_sym :=
        factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = x_order))

    total_df <- total_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(!!class_sym :=
        factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = x_order))

  } else if (is.null(facet_sym)) {

    class_order <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!class_sym) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        order_val = sum(
          ifelse(
            .data[[category_name]] %in% c("Detrimental", "Lethal"),
            .data[[percent_name]],
            0
          ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(order_val)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(!!class_sym)

    summary_df <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(!!class_sym :=
        factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = class_order))

    total_df <- total_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(!!class_sym :=
        factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = class_order))
  }

  # ---- Base plot ----
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    summary_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[class_name]],
      y = .data[[percent_name]],
      fill = .data[[category_name]]
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      position = "stack",
      width = 0.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Beneficial"  = "#A1A9D0",
        "Neutral"     = "#D9D9D9",
        "Detrimental" = "#F4A6A6",
        "Lethal"      = "#F0988C"
      ),
      name = fill_legend_title,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Class",
      y = "Proportion (%)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  # ---- Y-axis (STRICT 0–100 + label space) ----
  p <- p +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      #limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 110))

  # ---- Add total count labels above bars ----
  p <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = total_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[class_name]],
        y = 102,   # slightly above bar top (more robust than 105)
        label = scales::comma(total_count)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.5,
      vjust = 0
    )

  # ---- Faceting ----
  if (!is.null(facet_sym)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      vars(!!facet_sym),
      scales = "free_x"
    )
  }

  # ---- External statistics ----
  if (!is.null(stat_df) &&
      stat_position != "none" &&
      is.null(facet_sym)) {

    if (!stat_p_col %in% colnames(stat_df)) {
      stop("stat_p_col not found in stat_df.")
    }

    p_val <- stat_df[[stat_p_col]][1]

    if (stat_format == "p") {
      stat_label <- ifelse(
        p_val < 2.2e-16,
        "p < 2.2e-16",
        paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
      )
    } else {
      stat_label <- dplyr::case_when(
        p_val < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_val < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_val < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    }

    if (stat_position == "subtitle") {
      p <- p + ggplot2::labs(
        subtitle = paste0("Chi-square test: ", stat_label)
      )
    } else if (stat_position == "caption") {
      p <- p + ggplot2::labs(
        caption = paste0("Chi-square test: ", stat_label)
      )
    }
  }

  return(p)
}

## Counts
bar_count_stacked_proteome <- function(
    summary_df,
    class_col = Class,
    category_col = Category,
    count_col = count,
    plot_title = "Mutation Count by Class",
    fill_legend_title = "Mutation Category",
    x_order = NULL,
    facet_col = NULL,
    stat_df = NULL,
    stat_p_col = "p_value",
    stat_format = c("p", "stars"),
    stat_position = c("subtitle", "caption", "none"),
    label_size = 3.5,
    label_color = "black",
    label_vjust = 0,
    label_offset_frac = 0.03,
    y_expand_frac = 0.15
) {
  
  stat_format   <- match.arg(stat_format)
  stat_position <- match.arg(stat_position)
  
  # ---- Symbols ----
  class_sym    <- rlang::ensym(class_col)
  category_sym <- rlang::ensym(category_col)
  count_sym    <- rlang::ensym(count_col)
  facet_sym    <- if (!is.null(facet_col)) rlang::ensym(facet_col) else NULL
  
  class_name    <- rlang::as_name(class_sym)
  category_name <- rlang::as_name(category_sym)
  count_name    <- rlang::as_name(count_sym)
  
  # ---- Grouping variables ----
  grouping_vars <- if (is.null(facet_sym)) {
    list(class_sym, category_sym)
  } else {
    list(facet_sym, class_sym, category_sym)
  }
  
  group_class_vars <- if (is.null(facet_sym)) {
    list(class_sym)
  } else {
    list(facet_sym, class_sym)
  }
  
  # ---- Clean and aggregate ----
  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(!!class_sym),
      !is.na(!!category_sym)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!grouping_vars) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      !!count_sym := sum(!!count_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # ---- Category order ----
  summary_df[[category_name]] <- factor(
    summary_df[[category_name]],
    levels = c("Beneficial", "Neutral", "Detrimental", "Lethal"),
    ordered = TRUE
  )
  
  # ---- Total counts per bar ----
  totals_df <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!!group_class_vars) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_count = sum(!!count_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # ---- X-axis ordering ----
  if (!is.null(x_order)) {
    
    summary_df <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!class_sym := factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = x_order)
      )
    
    totals_df <- totals_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!class_sym := factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = x_order)
      )
    
  } else if (is.null(facet_sym)) {
    
    class_order <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!class_sym) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        order_val = sum(
          ifelse(
            .data[[category_name]] %in% c("Detrimental", "Lethal"),
            .data[[count_name]],
            0
          ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(order_val)) %>%
      dplyr::pull(!!class_sym)
    
    summary_df <- summary_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!class_sym := factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = class_order)
      )
    
    totals_df <- totals_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!class_sym := factor(.data[[class_name]], levels = class_order)
      )
  }
  
  # ---- Y-axis label position ----
  y_max <- max(totals_df$total_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (!is.finite(y_max) || y_max == 0) {
    y_max <- 1
  }
  
  totals_df <- totals_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_y = total_count + label_offset_frac * y_max
    )
  
  # ---- Base plot ----
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    summary_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[class_name]],
      y = .data[[count_name]],
      fill = .data[[category_name]]
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      position = "stack",
      width = 0.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = totals_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[class_name]],
        y = label_y,
        label = scales::comma(total_count)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = label_size,
      color = label_color,
      vjust = label_vjust
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Beneficial"  = "#A1A9D0",
        "Neutral"     = "#D9D9D9",
        "Detrimental" = "#F4A6A6",
        "Lethal"      = "#F0988C"
      ),
      name = fill_legend_title,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, y_max * (1 + y_expand_frac))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Class",
      y = "Mutation count"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  # ---- Faceting ----
  if (!is.null(facet_sym)) {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(
        vars(!!facet_sym),
        scales = "free_x"
      )
  }
  
  # ---- External statistics ----
  if (!is.null(stat_df) &&
      stat_position != "none" &&
      is.null(facet_sym)) {
    
    if (!stat_p_col %in% colnames(stat_df)) {
      stop("stat_p_col not found in stat_df.")
    }
    
    p_val <- stat_df[[stat_p_col]][1]
    
    if (stat_format == "p") {
      stat_label <- ifelse(
        p_val < 2.2e-16,
        "p < 2.2e-16",
        paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
      )
    } else {
      stat_label <- dplyr::case_when(
        p_val < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_val < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_val < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    }
    
    if (stat_position == "subtitle") {
      p <- p +
        ggplot2::labs(
          subtitle = paste0("Chi-square test: ", stat_label)
        )
    } else if (stat_position == "caption") {
      p <- p +
        ggplot2::labs(
          caption = paste0("Chi-square test: ", stat_label)
        )
    }
  }
  
  return(p)
}


# 2) Essential Residue Category & Mechanistic Category
bar_percent_stacked_protein_factor <- function(
  data,
  factor_col,
  count_col = count,
  palette = NULL,
  title = "Percentage within each gene",
  legend_title = "Class",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  x_order = NULL,
  order_by = "Interface"
) {

  factor_sym <- rlang::ensym(factor_col)
  count_sym  <- rlang::ensym(count_col)

  factor_name <- rlang::as_name(factor_sym)
  count_name  <- rlang::as_name(count_sym)

  # --- Step 1: Aggregate counts ---
  percent_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!factor_sym)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(aa_mut_gene, !!factor_sym) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      !!count_sym := sum(!!count_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- Step 2: Ensure all x_order + factor levels exist ---
  if (!is.null(x_order)) {

    factor_levels <- if (!is.null(palette) && !is.null(names(palette))) {
      names(palette)
    } else {
      unique(percent_data[[factor_name]])
    }

    percent_data <- percent_data %>%
      tidyr::complete(
        aa_mut_gene = x_order,
        !!factor_sym := factor_levels,
        fill = setNames(list(0), count_name)
      )
  }

  # --- Step 3: Recalculate percentages ---
  percent_data <- percent_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(aa_mut_gene) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = sum(.data[[count_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      percent = dplyr::if_else(
        total > 0,
        100 * .data[[count_name]] / total,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # --- Step 4: Total counts ---
  total_df <- percent_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(aa_mut_gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_count = sum(.data[[count_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (!is.null(x_order)) {
    total_df <- tibble::tibble(aa_mut_gene = x_order) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(total_df, by = "aa_mut_gene") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(total_count = tidyr::replace_na(total_count, 0))
  }

  # --- Step 5: Factor levels ---
  if (!is.null(palette) && !is.null(names(palette))) {
    percent_data[[factor_name]] <- factor(
      percent_data[[factor_name]],
      levels = names(palette)
    )
  }

  # --- Step 6: X ordering ---
  if (!is.null(x_order)) {

    percent_data <- percent_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(aa_mut_gene = factor(aa_mut_gene, levels = x_order))

    total_df <- total_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(aa_mut_gene = factor(aa_mut_gene, levels = x_order))

  } else {

    order_df <- percent_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[[factor_name]] == order_by) %>%
      dplyr::select(aa_mut_gene, percent)

    percent_data <- percent_data %>%
      dplyr::left_join(order_df, by = "aa_mut_gene", suffix = c("", "_order")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(percent_order = tidyr::replace_na(percent_order, -1)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        aa_mut_gene = forcats::fct_reorder(aa_mut_gene, percent_order, .desc = TRUE)
      )

    total_df <- total_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        aa_mut_gene = factor(aa_mut_gene, levels = levels(percent_data$aa_mut_gene))
      )
  }

  # --- Step 7: Plot ---
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    percent_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = aa_mut_gene,
      y = percent,
      fill = .data[[factor_name]]
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      width = 0.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = total_df,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = aa_mut_gene,
        y = 103,   # safe position above bars
        label = scales::comma(total_count)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 110)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Gene",
      y = "Proportion (%)",
      fill = if (show_legend) legend_title else NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

  # --- Step 8: Palette ---
  if (!is.null(palette)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = palette,
      drop = FALSE,
      na.value = "white"
    )
  }

  return(p)
}


# Function For Normal Heatmaps (Fitness and RSASA)
# 1) original heatmap function
plot_heatmap <- function(data,
                         pos_col = "pos",
                         sub_col = "sub",
                         wt_col  = "wt",  
                         value_col = "fitness",
                         plot_title = "",
                         show_legend = FALSE,
                         show_title = FALSE,
                         x_tick_step = 10,
                         x_label = "Position",   # Add x-axis label
                         y_label = "Mutant AA"    # Add y-axis label
                         ) {

  # Convert to symbols
  pos_sym <- rlang::sym(pos_col)
  sub_sym <- rlang::sym(sub_col)
  wt_sym  <- rlang::sym(wt_col)
  val_sym <- rlang::sym(value_col)

  # Generate x-axis breaks every x_tick_step
  x_breaks <- sort(unique(data[[pos_col]]))
  x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks %% x_tick_step == 0]

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = !!pos_sym, y = !!sub_sym, fill = !!val_sym)) +
    #geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1, color = "white") +
    #geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
    geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    coord_fixed() +

    # WT marker
    geom_point(
      aes(x = !!pos_sym, y = !!wt_sym),
      shape = 4, size = 0.4, color = "black", stroke = 0.3,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    # Scales
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      breaks = x_breaks
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("darkred", "red", "gray88", "blue"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(-1, 0, 1, 1.5)),
      limits = c(-1, 1.5),
      name = value_col,
      guide = if (show_legend) guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 10, barheight = 1,
        direction = "horizontal",
        ticks.colour = "black",
        title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5
      ) else "none"
    ) +

    # Theme
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      #axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

  # Title
  if (show_title) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(plot_title)
  }

  # Set custom axis labels
  if (!is.null(x_label)) {
    p <- p + xlab(x_label)
  }
  if (!is.null(y_label)) {
    p <- p + ylab(y_label)
  }

  return(p)
}

# 2) color wt with the reference
plot_heatmap_colored_wt <- function(
  data,
  pos_col = "pos",
  sub_col = "sub",
  wt_col  = "wt",
  value_col = "fitness",
  wt_value = 1,   # NEW: value assigned to WT tiles
  plot_title = "",
  show_legend = FALSE,
  show_title = FALSE,
  x_tick_step = 10,
  x_label = "Position",
  y_label = "Mutant AA"
) {

  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(rlang)

  # ---- Symbols ----
  pos_sym <- sym(pos_col)
  sub_sym <- sym(sub_col)
  wt_sym  <- sym(wt_col)
  val_sym <- sym(value_col)

  # ---- Step 1: Create WT rows ----
  wt_rows <- data %>%
    distinct(!!pos_sym, !!wt_sym) %>%
    mutate(
      !!sub_sym := !!wt_sym,
      !!val_sym := wt_value
    )

  # ---- Step 2: Combine with original data ----
  data_plot <- bind_rows(data, wt_rows)

  # ---- Step 3: x-axis breaks ----
  x_vals <- sort(unique(data_plot[[pos_col]]))
  x_breaks <- x_vals[x_vals %% x_tick_step == 0]

  # ---- Step 4: Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = !!pos_sym, y = !!sub_sym, fill = !!val_sym)) +

    geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    coord_fixed() +

    # ---- WT marker (on top) ----
    geom_point(
      data = wt_rows,
      aes(x = !!pos_sym, y = !!sub_sym),
      shape = 4,
      size = 0.4,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    # ---- Scales ----
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0),
      breaks = x_breaks
    ) +

    scale_y_discrete(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("darkred", "red", "gray88", "blue"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(-1, 0, 1, 1.5)),
      limits = c(-1, 1.5),
      name = value_col,
      guide = if (show_legend) guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 10,
        barheight = 1,
        direction = "horizontal",
        ticks.colour = "black",
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      ) else "none"
    ) +

    # ---- Theme ----
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

  # ---- Title ----
  if (show_title) {
    p <- p + ggtitle(plot_title)
  }

  # ---- Axis labels ----
  if (!is.null(x_label)) {
    p <- p + xlab(x_label)
  }
  if (!is.null(y_label)) {
    p <- p + ylab(y_label)
  }

  return(p)
}


# Function for Subset Fitness Heatmaps
# 1) original subset Fitness Heatmaps
plot_heatmap_subset <- function(data,
                               pos_col = "pos",
                               sub_col = "sub",
                               wt_col  = "wt",
                               value_col = "fitness",
                               plot_title = "",
                               show_legend = TRUE,
                               x_label = "Position",
                               y_label = "Mutant AA") {

  # ---- Basic input validation ----
  stopifnot(all(c(pos_col, sub_col, wt_col, value_col) %in% names(data)))

  # ---- Clean the data ----
  df <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[pos_col]]),
                  !is.na(.data[[sub_col]]),
                  !is.na(.data[[value_col]]))

  # ---- Convert position to discrete factor (important!) ----
  df[[pos_col]] <- factor(df[[pos_col]], levels = sort(unique(df[[pos_col]])))

  # ---- Build WT outline ----
  wt_outline <- df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data[[pos_col]], .data[[wt_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::rename(pos = !!sym(pos_col), wt = !!sym(wt_col)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sub = wt)

  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[pos_col]], y = .data[[sub_col]], fill = .data[[value_col]])) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", width = 0.95, height = 0.95) +   # tighter fill for nice grid
    
    #geom_tile(
      #data = wt_outline,
      #aes(x = pos, y = sub),
      #fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2,
      #inherit.aes = FALSE
    #) +
    
    geom_point(
      data = wt_rows,
      aes(x = !!pos_sym, y = !!sub_sym),
      shape = 4,
      size = 0.4,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.4,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +   # discrete = no gaps
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("darkred", "red", "gray88", "blue"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(-1, 0, 1, 1.5)),
      limits = c(-1, 1.5),
      name = value_col,
      guide = if (show_legend) guide_colorbar(
        barwidth = 10, barheight = 1,
        direction = "horizontal",
        ticks.colour = "black",
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      ) else "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "top" else "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
    )

  return(p)
}
```

## Load WT PhiX Genome and Protein Sequences
To update the aa mut annotations at protein level data.frames;
```{r}
# Load the WT phiX174 genome sequence (Promega RFI, WT is acquired through SDM of am3 on Gene E)
phix_wt <- read.table("./data/mutant_library_data/phix_wt_genome_seq_promega.txt")
str_length(phix_wt$x) # 5386bp, matching genome map on Benchling;
phix_wt_seq <- phix_wt$x

# Add genome annotations 
# ref https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/gene/taxon/2886930/
# In total, 11* ORF, list their nt and aa sequence, and invert selections of the genome sequence
#gpA, DNA replication initiation, 3981-136, 1542nt = 513AA + stop* = 514 postions;
target_seq_A_phix174p01_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 3981, 5386)
target_seq_A_phix174p01_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 136)
target_seq_A_phix174p01 <- paste0(target_seq_A_phix174p01_5, target_seq_A_phix174p01_3)
target_seq_A_phix174p01_invert <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 137, 3980)
gpA_aa_seq_phix174p01 = c2s(translate(s2c(tolower(target_seq_A_phix174p01)),frame = 0)) #mut from start codon
str_length(gpA_aa_seq_phix174p01) #514 aa mut positions, full length of gpA;

#gpA2, DNA replication initiation, 4497-136, 1026nt = 341AA + stop* = 342 positions;
target_seq_A2_phix174p02_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 4497,5386)

#gpC, terminase, 133-393, 261nt = 86AA + stop* = 262 positions;

#gpF, major head protein, 1001-2284, 1284nt = 427AA + stop* = 428 positions;

target_seq_E_phix174p08_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 567)
target_seq_E_phix174p08_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 844, 5386)
gpE_aa_seq_phix174p08 = c2s(translate(s2c(tolower(target_seq_E_phix174p08)),frame = 0)) #mut from start codon
str_length(gpE_aa_seq_phix174p08) #92 aa mut positions, full length of gpE

#gpJ, DNA condensation, 848-964, 117nt = 38AA + stop* = 39 positions;
target_seq_J_phix174p09 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 848, 964)
target_seq_J_phix174p09_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 847)
target_seq_J_phix174p09_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 965, 5386)
gpJ_aa_seq_phix174p09 = c2s(translate(s2c(tolower(target_seq_J_phix174p09)),frame = 0)) #mut from start codon
str_length(gpJ_aa_seq_phix174p09) #39 aa mut positions, full length of gpJ

#gpG, major spike protein, 2395-2922, 528nt = 175AA + stop* = 176 positions;
target_seq_G_phix174p10 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2395, 2922)
target_seq_G_phix174p10_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 2394)
target_seq_G_phix174p10_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2923, 5386)
gpG_aa_seq_phix174p10 = c2s(translate(s2c(tolower(target_seq_G_phix174p10)),frame = 0)) #mut from start codon
str_length(gpG_aa_seq_phix174p10) #176 aa mut positions, full length of gpG

#gpH, pilot protein for DNA ejection, 2931-3917, 987nt = 328AA + stop* = 329AA;
target_seq_H_phix174p11 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2931, 3917)
target_seq_H_phix174p11_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 2930)
target_seq_H_phix174p11_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 3918, 5386)
gpH_aa_seq_phix174p11 = c2s(translate(s2c(tolower(target_seq_H_phix174p11)),frame = 0)) #mut from start codon
str_length(gpH_aa_seq_phix174p11) #329 aa mut positions, full length of gpH

# Add Noncoding regions, for InDels design
# Noncoding#1, 965-1000, 36bp between p09_J and p06_F;
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_01 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 965, 1000)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_01_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 964)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_01_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1001, 5386)

# Noncoding#2, 2285-2394, 110bp between p06_F and p10_G;
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_02 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2285, 2394)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_02_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 2284)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_02_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2395, 5386)

# Noncoding#3, 2923-2930, 8bp between p10_G and p11_H; (same sequence in another frame of gpF, 2132-2139)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_03 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2923, 2930)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_03_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 2922)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_03_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 2931, 5386)

# Noncoding#4, 3918-3980, 63bp between p11_H and p01_A;
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_04 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 3918, 3980)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_04_invert_5 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 1, 3917)
target_seq_phix174_noncoding_04_invert_3 <- str_sub(phix_wt_seq, 3981, 5386)
```

## Get Protein Data.rames
Only take data with gene aa ham = 0 or 1 [Synonymous or single AA mutations];

All 11x phix proteins are grouped into 'mut1', 'mut2', 'mut3' columns of AA mut info;
	# gene_mut1: D, F, H, K
	# gene_mut2: B, C, E
	# gene_mut3: A(A*), G, J 
	  # A* data can be subset from A by aa mut pos;
Subset their data by gene_mut1 aa mut == "Gene Name", and create separate data.frames;

## Update annotations and Statistics
### 1) 1aa Synonymous mutations
1) Update single-amino-acid mutations annotations (e.g. change 'syn')
2) combine as pre-proteome - 'phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique'
3) make a copy for statistics - 'phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique_stat'
4) get synonymous references
5) run statistic tests and mutation category together with substitutions

```{r}
## 2) tune aa position
# This is to match structural annotations
# F, mut

# J, mut3

phix_protein_J_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique$aa_mut_pos <- phix_protein_J_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique$aa_mut_pos - 1



# 3) combine protein synonymous mutation-level data.frames
phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique <- bind_rows(
  phix_protein_D_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique,
  phix_protein_F_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique,
  phix_protein_H_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique,
  phix_protein_K_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique,

  phix_protein_G_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique,
  phix_protein_J_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique
)
head(as.data.frame(phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique), 0)
nrow(phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique) 
# [1] 1588x



# 4) get weighted.mean of all 1nt synonymous mutations
phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_weights <- 1 / (phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique$sem_aa_mut^2)  # Weights are the inverse of variance
phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_fitness_final <- sum(phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique$fitness_aa_mut * phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_weights) / sum(phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_weights) 
# [1] 0.9780762
phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_sigma_final <- sqrt(1/sum(phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_weights)) 
# [1] 0.0002403682



# 5) make a copy for statistics
phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique_stat <- phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique
```

### 3) Statistic test and Mutation category
1) combine 1aa Synonymous and Substitutions
2) run statistic tests at single-amino-acid level

```{r}
# check data 
head(as.data.frame(phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique_stat), 0)
head(as.data.frame(phix_pre_proteome_dms_sub_mut_Fitness_unique_stat), 0)


# 1) combine 1aa syn and sub mutations
phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat <- bind_rows(
  phix_pre_proteome_dms_syn_mut_Fitness_unique_stat,
  phix_pre_proteome_dms_sub_mut_Fitness_unique_stat
)
nrow(phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat) 
# [1] 48136


# 2) Statistic test: two-sample t-test compared with synonymous ref
phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$p_value_1aa_two_sample_ttest_syn <- mapply(
  two_samples_ttest,
  phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$fitness_aa_mut,  # mu1 (row-wise)
  phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$sem_aa_mut,    # sem1 (row-wise)
  
  MoreArgs = list(
    n1 = 3,  # Fixed (n1),
    mu2 = phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_fitness_final,  # Fixed (mu2)
    sem2 = phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_sigma_final,   # Fixed (sem2)
    n2 = 3  # Fixed (n2)
  )
)

# Apply FDR correction using the function p.adjust() from basic R;
phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat <- phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat %>%
  mutate(p_value_1aa_two_sample_ttest_syn_FDR = p.adjust(p_value_1aa_two_sample_ttest_syn, method = "BH"))


# Add raw effect size (difference from the synonymous baseline)
phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$effect_size_vs_1aa_syn <-
  phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$fitness_aa_mut -
  phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_fitness_final


# Add standardized effect (signal-to-noise; same scaling as t-stat numerator)
phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$effect_size_std_vs_1aa_syn <-
  (phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$fitness_aa_mut -
   phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_fitness_final) /
  sqrt(phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat$sem_aa_mut^2 +
       phix_1aa_synonymous_combined_sigma_final^2)



# 3) Mutation Category, by mutation-level fitness and FDR
phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat <- assign_mutation_categories_fdr(
  phix_pre_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_stat,
  pval_col = "p_value_1aa_two_sample_ttest_syn_FDR",
  effect_raw_col = "effect_size_vs_1aa_syn",
  
  #alpha = 0.1,
  alpha = 0.05, # Show all neutral
  effect_breaks = c(0.10, 0.15, 0.50),

  # Output column names
  effect_bin_col = "effect_size_bin_1aa",
  category_fdr_col = "mutation_category_FDR_1aa",
  category_fdr_lethal_col = "mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa",
  category_cutoff_col = "mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_1aa",
  category_combined_col = "mutation_category_FDR_cutoff_1aa_combined",
  
  direction_col = "mutation_direction_1aa",
  direction_lethal_col = "mutation_direction_lethal_1aa"
)
```

## Merge Fitness Data with Structural Data
Use the protein data.frames with unique aa mut ID;

### 1) ssdraw structural annotations - m1
bio3d, get the 2nd structure info from structure files;

Combine secondary structural annotations - secondary_structure_ss, updated:
  1) D, from 1CD3, including D1, D2, D3, D4;
  2) F, from 1CD3 and 2BPA;
  3) H, from PDB-4JPP;
  4) K, from the top-ranked AlphaFold 3 model;
  5) B, from 1CD3
  6) C, from the top-ranked AlphaFold 3 model;
  7) E, from PDB-8G02, including Chain B and Chain G
  8) A, from the top-ranked AlphaFold 3 model;
  9) G, from 1CD3 and 2BPA;
  10) J, from 2BPA;


### 3) Combine PPI annotations - m3
1) Aggregate and integrate protein–protein interaction (PPI) and structural annotations at the residue level.
  – FUNCTION: combine_protein_ppi_info()
      paste_binder_genes(output_col = "binder_genes") %>%
      paste_binder_classes(output_col = "binder_classes") %>%
      paste_binder_complexes(output_col = "binder_complexes") %>%
      paste_monomer_structural_class(output_col = "monomer_structural_class") %>%
      merge_structural_context(binder_col = "binder_genes",
        monomer_col = "monomer_structural_class",
        output_col = "residue_structural_class"
      )
2) Supplement 'Unknown' for residues missing in the structures

```{r}
## 1) Mutation Level
# mut
phix_protein_D_dms_mut_Fitness_m3 <- combine_protein_ppi_info(phix_protein_D_dms_mut_Fitness_m2)
table(phix_protein_D_dms_mut_Fitness_m3$residue_structural_class)

phix_protein_F_dms_mut_Fitness_m3 <- combine_protein_ppi_info(phix_protein_F_dms_mut_Fitness_m2) %>%
  mutate(residue_structural_class = case_when(
    gene_sub_aa_mut_pos == 0 ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ residue_structural_class  # retain existing residue_structural_class values
  )) %>%
  mutate(monomer_structural_class = case_when(
    gene_sub_aa_mut_pos == 0 ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ monomer_structural_class  # retain existing residue_structural_class values
  ))
table(phix_protein_F_dms_mut_Fitness_m3$residue_structural_class)

phix_protein_H_dms_mut_Fitness_m3 <- combine_protein_ppi_info(phix_protein_H_dms_mut_Fitness_m2)
phix_protein_H_dms_mut_Fitness_m3 <- phix_protein_H_dms_mut_Fitness_m3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(monomer_structural_class, residue_structural_class),
      ~ ifelse(
        is.na(.x) & aa_mut_wt != "*",
        "Unknown",
        .x
      )
    )
  )
table(phix_protein_H_dms_mut_Fitness_m3$residue_structural_class)

#   2435     251    4126
```

## Prepare Scoring Files
Fitness scoring files for coloring structures in ChimeraX.
```{r}
# Function to prepare ChimeraX scoring files from position and fitness median
prepare_chimerax_scoring_file <- function(df, output_file, fitness_col = "Fitness_median") {
  # Filter valid entries
  df_filtered <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(aa_mut_pos), !is.na(.data[[fitness_col]]))

  # Format lines for ChimeraX
  chimera_lines <- paste0("\t:", df_filtered$aa_mut_pos, "\t", df_filtered[[fitness_col]])
  chimera_output <- c("attribute: fitness", "recipient: residues", chimera_lines)

  # Write to output file
  writeLines(chimera_output, con = output_file)
}
```

## Advance structural annotations by AlphaFold 3 
- Separate Annotations From Resolved and Predicted structures
1) Simplify the residue_structural_group annotations: based on residue_structural_group and combine c("No Structure", "Other Surface") ~ "Unknown"; 
2) Resolved ($residue_structural_group_resolved): based simplified annotations, modify A, A*, C, K, H_1-143 and H_273-328 ~ "Unknown"
2) Predicted ($residue_structural_group_predicted): based on resolved annotations, add AlphaFold 3 predictions by integrating Alphafold 3 predictions analysis for A-DNA and A-C interactions;

### 0) load functions to process advanced datasets
```{r}
# Function to build look-up table for A core / surface
make_A_core_surface_lookup <- function(
  A_position_table,
  gene_name = "A",
  astar_offset = 172
) {
  
  A_lookup <- A_position_table %>%
    filter(
      residue_structural_group %in% c("Core", "Other Surface", "Non-interface surface")
    ) %>%
    distinct(
      aa_mut_pos,
      residue_structural_group
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      aa_mut_gene = gene_name,
      structural_group_lookup = case_when(
        residue_structural_group == "Core" ~ "Core",
        residue_structural_group %in% c("Other Surface", "Non-interface surface") ~ "Non-interface surface",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      aa_mut_gene,
      aa_mut_pos,
      structural_group_lookup
    )
  
  Astar_lookup <- A_lookup %>%
    mutate(
      aa_mut_gene = "Astar",
      aa_mut_pos = aa_mut_pos - astar_offset
    ) %>%
    filter(aa_mut_pos > 0)
  
  bind_rows(A_lookup, Astar_lookup) %>%
    distinct(
      aa_mut_gene,
      aa_mut_pos,
      structural_group_lookup
    ) %>%
    arrange(aa_mut_gene, aa_mut_pos)
}


# Function to build expanded AF3 interface lookup table
make_af3_interface_lookup_expanded <- function(
  af3_interface_lookup_table,
  astar_offset = 172
) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  
  Astar_interface_lookup <- af3_interface_lookup_table %>%
    filter(aa_mut_gene == "A") %>%
    mutate(
      aa_mut_gene = "Astar",
      aa_mut_pos = aa_mut_pos - astar_offset
    ) %>%
    filter(aa_mut_pos > 0)
  
  bind_rows(
    af3_interface_lookup_table,
    Astar_interface_lookup
  ) %>%
    group_by(aa_mut_gene, aa_mut_pos) %>%
    summarise(
      af3_interaction_partner = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(interaction_partner, ",")))),
        collapse = ","
      ),
      
      af3_n_interaction_partners = n_distinct(
        unlist(strsplit(interaction_partner, ","))
      ),
      
      af3_total_atomic_contacts = sum(total_atomic_contacts, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      af3_n_models_detected = sum(n_models_detected, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      af3_model_names = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(model_names, ",")))),
        collapse = ","
      ),
      
      af3_binder_complexes = if ("binder_complexes" %in% names(cur_data())) {
        paste(
          sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(binder_complexes, ",")))),
          collapse = ","
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      
      af3_is_interface_residue = any(is_interface_residue),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(aa_mut_gene, aa_mut_pos)
}


# Function to process AF3 binder information
get_af3_binder_classes <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  partners <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))
  partners <- partners[partners != ""]
  
  classes <- dplyr::case_when(
    partners == "DNA" ~ "PDI",
    partners == "MG"  ~ "Ion",
    TRUE              ~ "PPI"
  )
  
  paste(sort(unique(classes)), collapse = ",")
}

get_interaction_class <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  partners <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))
  partners <- partners[partners != ""]
  
  n_partners <- length(unique(partners))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    n_partners >= 2 ~ "Multi-interaction",
    n_partners == 1 ~ "Single-interaction",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}



```

```{r}
  { . - 172 } %>%        # subtract 172
  .[. > 0] %>%           # keep only values > 0
  paste(collapse = ",")

phix_protein_A_top_model0_surface %>%
  { . - 172 } %>%        # subtract 172
  .[. > 0] %>%           # keep only values > 0
  paste(collapse = ",")

# build Core/Surface lookup
A_core_surface_lookup <- make_A_core_surface_lookup(
  A_position_table = phix_protein_A_dms_aa_pos_Fitness_m5
)


# 2) get interface residues from A-DNA and A-C models
load(file = "./data/proteins_data/PPI_data/af3_interface_lookup_table.RData")

head(as.data.frame(af3_interface_lookup_table), 2)

af3_interface_lookup_table_expanded <- make_af3_interface_lookup_expanded(
  af3_interface_lookup_table
)


# 3) combine look
af3_structural_lookup_full <- A_core_surface_lookup %>%
  full_join(
    af3_interface_lookup_table_expanded,
    by = c("aa_mut_gene", "aa_mut_pos")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    af3_is_interface_residue = ifelse(
      is.na(af3_is_interface_residue),
      FALSE,
      af3_is_interface_residue
    ),
    
    af3_n_interaction_partners = ifelse(
      is.na(af3_n_interaction_partners),
      0L,
      af3_n_interaction_partners
    ),
    
    af3_total_atomic_contacts = ifelse(
      is.na(af3_total_atomic_contacts),
      0L,
      af3_total_atomic_contacts
    ),
    
    residue_structural_group_predicted_lookup = case_when(
      af3_is_interface_residue == TRUE ~ "Interface",
      !is.na(structural_group_lookup) ~ structural_group_lookup,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(aa_mut_gene, aa_mut_pos)

head(as.data.frame(af3_structural_lookup_full), 2)


# 4) extract annotations from the lookup table
af3_lookup_minimal <- af3_structural_lookup_full %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    aa_mut_gene,
    aa_mut_pos,
    
    af3_residue_structural_group = residue_structural_group_predicted_lookup,
    af3_binder_genes = af3_interaction_partner,
    af3_binder_complexes = af3_binder_complexes
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    aa_mut_gene,
    aa_mut_pos,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

af3_lookup_minimal %>%
  dplyr::count(aa_mut_gene, af3_residue_structural_group)
```

### 3) Advanced Mutations Data 
```{r}
# 1) check original data
head(as.data.frame(phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique), 0)


# 2) add AF3 annotations
phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced <- 
  phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique %>%
  
  # ---- Step 1: Simplify original classification ----
  dplyr::mutate(
    residue_structural_group_simplified = dplyr::case_when(
      residue_structural_group %in% c("No Structure") ~ "Unknown structure",
      residue_structural_group %in% c("Other Surface") ~ "Non-interface surface",
      residue_structural_group %in% c("Interacting") ~ "Interface",
      TRUE ~ residue_structural_group
    ),
    
    # ---- Step 2: Resolved version ----
    residue_structural_group_resolved = dplyr::case_when(
      aa_mut_gene %in% c("A", "Astar", "C", "K") ~ "Unknown structure",
      TRUE ~ residue_structural_group_simplified
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # ---- Step 3: Join AF3 lookup ----
  dplyr::left_join(
    af3_lookup_minimal,
    by = c("aa_mut_gene", "aa_mut_pos")
  ) %>%
  
  # ---- Step 4: Predicted structural annotation from lookup ----
  dplyr::mutate(
    residue_structural_group_predicted = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(af3_residue_structural_group) ~ af3_residue_structural_group,
      TRUE ~ residue_structural_group_resolved
    ),
    
    # ---- Monomer structural classes ----
    monomer_structural_class_resolved = dplyr::case_when(
      residue_structural_group_resolved == "Core" ~ "Core",
      residue_structural_group_resolved %in% c("Interface", "Non-interface surface") ~ "Surface",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    monomer_structural_class_predicted = dplyr::case_when(
      residue_structural_group_predicted == "Core" ~ "Core",
      residue_structural_group_predicted %in% c("Interface", "Non-interface surface") ~ "Surface",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # ---- Surface classification ----
    residue_surface_class_resolved = dplyr::case_when(
      residue_structural_group_resolved %in% c("Interface", "Non-interface surface") ~
        residue_structural_group_resolved,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    residue_surface_class_predicted = dplyr::case_when(
      residue_structural_group_predicted %in% c("Interface", "Non-interface surface") ~
        residue_structural_group_predicted,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # ---- Step 5: Overwrite binder information using AF3 partner annotations ----
  dplyr::mutate(
    binder_genes = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(af3_binder_genes) & af3_binder_genes != "" ~ af3_binder_genes,
      TRUE ~ binder_genes
    ),
    
    binder_classes = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(af3_binder_genes) & af3_binder_genes != "" ~ 
        sapply(af3_binder_genes, get_af3_binder_classes),
      TRUE ~ binder_classes
    ),
    
    binder_complexes = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(af3_binder_genes) & af3_binder_genes != "" &
        !is.na(af3_binder_complexes) & af3_binder_complexes != "" ~ af3_binder_complexes,
      
      !is.na(af3_binder_genes) & af3_binder_genes != "" ~ "AlphaFold 3",
      
      TRUE ~ binder_complexes
    ),
    
    binder_gene_count = sapply(binder_genes, function(x) {
      if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
        NA_integer_
      } else {
        length(unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))))
      }
    }),
    
    residue_interaction_class = sapply(
      binder_genes,
      get_interaction_class
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # ---- Step 6: Factor levels ----
  dplyr::mutate(
    residue_surface_class_resolved = factor(
      residue_surface_class_resolved,
      levels = c("Non-interface surface", "Interface")
    ),
    
    residue_surface_class_predicted = factor(
      residue_surface_class_predicted,
      levels = c("Non-interface surface", "Interface")
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # ---- Step 7: Remove structure annotation for stop codons ----
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(
        residue_structural_group_simplified,
        residue_structural_group_resolved,
        residue_structural_group_predicted,
        monomer_structural_class_resolved,
        monomer_structural_class_predicted,
        residue_surface_class_resolved,
        residue_surface_class_predicted,
        residue_structural_group,
        residue_surface_class,
        monomer_structural_class,
        residue_structural_class,
        residue_binding_type,
        residue_interaction_class,
        binder_genes,
        binder_classes,
        binder_complexes
      ),
      ~ ifelse(
        aa_mut_wt == "*",
        NA_character_,
        as.character(.)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # ---- Step 8: Remove temporary AF3 columns if you do not want them ----
  dplyr::select(
    -af3_residue_structural_group,
    -af3_binder_genes,
    -af3_binder_complexes
  )


# check advanced annotations
phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced %>%
  dplyr::count(aa_mut_gene, binder_genes, residue_interaction_class)

phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced %>%
  dplyr::filter(aa_mut_gene %in% c("A", "Astar", "C")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    aa_mut_gene,
    aa_mut_pos,
    residue_structural_group_predicted,
    binder_genes,
    binder_classes,
    binder_complexes,
    residue_interaction_class
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(aa_mut_gene, aa_mut_pos)


## Saving the advanced proteome data.frame
save(phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced, file = "./data/proteins_data/plotting_data/phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced.RData")
write_tsv(phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced, file = "./data/fitness_data/phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced.tsv")
# renamed 'Supplementary_file_phix_1aa_variants_fitness.tsv'



```

```{r}
## Loop odds ratio calculation
# 1) define ranges 
phix_genes <- unique(phix_proteome_dms_mut_missense_analysis$aa_mut_gene)


# 2) analysis plan
odds_ratio_analysis <- expand.grid(
  subset = c("all", "single_orf"),
  
  #exposure = c("residue_structural_group", "monomer_structural_class", "residue_surface_class"),
  exposure = c("residue_structural_group_predicted", "monomer_structural_class_predicted", "residue_surface_class_predicted"),
  
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

exposure_focus_list <- list(
  #residue_structural_group = c("Core","Interacting","Other Surface","No Structure"),
  #monomer_structural_class = c("Core","Surface","Unknown"),
  #residue_surface_class = c("Interacting", "Other Surface")
  
  residue_structural_group_predicted = c("Core","Interface","Non-interface surface","Unknown structure"),
  monomer_structural_class_predicted = c("Core","Surface"),
  residue_surface_class_predicted = c("Interface", "Non-interface surface")
)


# 3) list all data 
phix_proteome_mut_data_advanced_list <- list(
  all = phix_proteome_dms_mut_Fitness_unique_advanced,
  single_orf = phix_proteome_dms_mut_missense_analysis
)


# 3) run Odds Ratio calculation
odds_ratio_mut_advanced_analysis_results <- run_or_pipeline(
  dataset_list = phix_proteome_mut_data_advanced_list,
  
  analysis_plan = odds_ratio_analysis,
  exposure_focus_list = exposure_focus_list,
  outcome_col = mutation_category_FDR_lethal_1aa,
  outcome_focus = c("Detrimental", "Lethal"),
  
  #group_col = NULL # Overall proteome
  group_col = "aa_mut_gene" # Group by proteins
)


# 4) save enrichment test results
# proteome level 
odds_ratio_proteome_structural_classes <- odds_ratio_mut_advanced_analysis_results %>%
  filter(subset == "single_orf") %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    odds_ratio_plot = pmin(odds_ratio, 10) # Cap the values for visiulization
  )
table(odds_ratio_proteome_structural_classes$exposure_var)

## Saving the advanced proteome data.frame
save(odds_ratio_proteome_structural_classes, file = "./data/proteins_data/plotting_data/odds_ratio_proteome_structural_classes.RData")
write_tsv(odds_ratio_proteome_structural_classes, file = "./data/fitness_data/odds_ratio_proteome_structural_classes.tsv")


# genes level
odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes <- odds_ratio_mut_advanced_analysis_results %>%
  filter(subset == "single_orf") %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    significant = p_adj < 0.05,
    odds_ratio_plot = pmin(odds_ratio, 10) # Cap the values for visiulization
  )
table(odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes$exposure_var)
table(odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes$group)

## Saving the advanced proteome data.frame
save(odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes, file = "./data/proteins_data/plotting_data/odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes.RData")
write_tsv(odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes, file = "./data/fitness_data/odds_ratio_genes_structural_classes.tsv")
```

```{r}
plot_df_beneficial_structural_count <- summary_proteome_mis_mut_advanced_beneficial_plot %>%
  filter(mutation_category_FDR_1aa == "Beneficial") %>%
  mutate(
    residue_structural_group_predicted = case_when(
      is.na(residue_structural_group_predicted) ~ "Unknown structure",
      residue_structural_group_predicted == "" ~ "Unknown structure",
      TRUE ~ residue_structural_group_predicted
    ),
    residue_structural_group_predicted = factor(
      residue_structural_group_predicted,
      levels = c(
        "Core",
        "Interface",
        "Non-interface surface",
        "Unknown structure"
      )
    ),
    aa_mut_gene = factor(aa_mut_gene)
  ) %>%
  group_by(aa_mut_gene, residue_structural_group_predicted) %>%
  summarise(
    count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

total_df_structural <- plot_df_beneficial_structural_count %>%
  group_by(aa_mut_gene) %>%
  summarise(
    total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  plot_df_beneficial_structural_count,

    x = aa_mut_gene,
    y = count,
    fill = residue_structural_group_predicted
  )

    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +

      x = aa_mut_gene,
      y = total_count + 0.04 * y_max_structural,
      label = scales::comma(total_count)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = structural_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, y_max_structural * 1.25)

  labs(
    title = "Beneficial mutations by structural group",
    x = "Gene",
    #y = "Number of beneficial mutations",
    y = "Counts",
    fill = "Structural group"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

### Core/Interface Heatmaps (Figure 2, S2)
```{r}
# check data
head(as.data.frame(phix_proteome_dms_aa_pos_Fitness_advanced), 0)
table(phix_proteome_dms_aa_pos_Fitness_advanced$residue_structural_group_predicted)


# extract core and interface information
phix_residue_core_interface_binary <- phix_proteome_dms_aa_pos_Fitness_advanced %>%
  select(
    aa_mut_gene,
    aa_mut_pos,
    residue_structural_group_predicted
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    is_core = case_when(
      residue_structural_group_predicted == "Core" ~ 100,
      is.na(residue_structural_group_predicted) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    is_interface = case_when(
      str_detect(residue_structural_group_predicted, "Interface") ~ 100,
      is.na(residue_structural_group_predicted) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# transform to long table
phix_residue_core_interface_heatmap_long <- phix_residue_core_interface_binary %>%
  select(
    aa_mut_gene,
    aa_mut_pos,
    is_core,
    is_interface
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(is_core, is_interface),
    names_to = "Class",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = recode(
      Class,
      is_core = "Core",
      is_interface = "Interface"
    ),
    Class = factor(Class, levels = c("Interface", "Core"))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    pos = aa_mut_pos,
    gene = aa_mut_gene
  )


# plotting
phix_core_interface_heatmaps <- phix_residue_core_interface_heatmap_long %>%
  split(.$gene) %>%
  lapply(function(df) {
    plot_heatmap_binary_class(
      data = df,
      pos_col = "pos",
      class_col = "Class",
      value_col = "Value",
      plot_title = paste0("Protein ", unique(df$gene)),
      show_title = TRUE,
      show_legend = FALSE,
      x_tick_step = 20,
      x_label = "Position",
      y_label = "Class"
    )
  })

# view heatmaps
phix_core_interface_heatmaps$C







```
